nodes.name: Accumulator
nodes.description: Accumulates specific map types such as Water, Forest, or Snow from all available nodes.

params.name: Type
optionDescriptions: Accumulate all snow as a flat mask.
Accumulate all Snow Depth at absolute values.
Accumulate all rivers.
Accumulate all water as a flat mask.
Accumulate all Water Depth in absolute values.
Accumulate all Shore masks.
Accumulate all DebrisMask (using Max mode)
Accumulate just the DebrisColor (using Max mode).
Accumulate all trees generated by Trees and Shrubs nodes.
Accumulate all dead zones in Trees nodes.
Accumulate all fresh water flows from Tree nodes.

params.name: Restrict to Group
params.description: Restricts accumulating from other nodes that are in the same Group as the Accumulator node.

nodes.name: Adjust
nodes.description: The Fx node makes that process easier by combining all the common adjustments inside a single node and allowing you to toggle them on and off.

params.name: Multiply
params.description: Multiplies each value by a specified factor.

params.name: Shaper
params.description: Applies a shaping function to modify the curve of values.

params.name: Clamp
params.description: Restricts values to a specified minimum and maximum range.

params.name: Clip
params.description: Limits values by cutting off those outside a given range.

params.name: Drop
params.description: Removes values below or above a certain threshold.

params.name: Autolevel
params.description: Automatically adjusts values to span the full output range.

params.name: Equalize
params.description: Redistributes values to achieve a more uniform distribution.

params.name: Strong
params.description: Enhances the contrast or intensity of values.

params.name: Invert
params.description: Flips values to their opposite within the range.

nodes.name: Anastomosis
nodes.description: Anastomosis creates interconnected water flow based extractions, ranging from small pits to large river channels. It is useful for both terrains and textures.

params.name: Impact
params.description: The intensity of the process. Higher values create stronger physical impacts within the erosion process.

params.name: Width
params.description: Controls the horizontal spread of the anastomosis effect. Larger values produce wider channels and features.

params.name: Depth
params.description: Determines the vertical extent of the erosion. Higher values result in deeper cuts and more pronounced terrain features.

params.name: Downcutting
params.description: Specifies the style and aggressiveness of vertical erosion. Select from various modes to control how the terrain is carved downward.
optionDescriptions: Applies aggressive downcutting, rapidly eroding and deepening channels.
Focuses erosion into localized depressions, creating pit-like features.
Simulates water flow erosion, carving smooth, continuous channels.
Emphasizes river-like downcutting, forming distinct riverbeds.
Doubles the intensity of river downcutting for deeper, more defined riverbeds.
Quadruples the river downcutting effect, producing extremely deep and prominent river channels.
Simulates broad, shallow erosion typical of flooding events.
Doubles the flooding effect, increasing the area and depth of flood erosion.
Quadruples the flooding effect, creating extensive and deep flood-eroded regions.

params.name: Quality
params.description: Sets the processing resolution for the node. Higher quality yields more detailed results at the cost of performance.
optionDescriptions: Processes at 1/4 resolution for fastest performance and lowest detail.
Processes at 1/3 resolution, balancing speed and detail.
Processes at 1/2 resolution for moderate detail and performance.
Processes at full resolution for maximum detail and slower performance.

params.name: Smooth Edges
params.description: Softens the edges of eroded features, reducing sharp transitions and creating a more natural appearance.

nodes.name: Angle
nodes.description: Angle creates a selection mask covering all areas of the heightfield facing the specified range.

params.name: Azimuth
params.description: The direction from which to start the selection.

params.name: Falloff
params.description: The soft falloff at the maximum angle.

nodes.name: AO
nodes.description: Creates an ambient occlusion map that darkens recessed areas and enhances terrain depth.

params.name: Quality
params.description: Sets the processing resolution for the ambient occlusion calculation. Higher quality provides more accurate and detailed results, but may increase computation time.
optionDescriptions: Fastest processing with minimal detail. Suitable for previews or low-fidelity outputs.
Balanced processing speed and detail. Recommended for general use.
High detail with slower processing. Use when fine ambient occlusion is required.
Maximum detail and accuracy. Best for final renders, but slowest to compute.

params.name: Enhance
params.description: Boosts the strength and clarity of the ambient occlusion effect, making shadows and depth more pronounced in the terrain.

nodes.name: Aperture
nodes.description: Aperture expands or compacts every feature on the terrain, similar to a camera's bokeh.

params.name: Information
params.description: Displays additional information or metadata about the aperture operation and its current settings.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Specifies the morphological operation to apply to the input, affecting how features are expanded or contracted.
optionDescriptions: Expands or grows features in the input by the specified shape and size, filling small holes and connecting nearby elements.
Contracts or shrinks features in the input by the specified shape and size, removing small details and separating connected elements.

params.name: Size
params.description: Sets the size of the structuring element (aperture) used for the operation. Larger values increase the effect's reach.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Determines the geometric shape of the structuring element used for dilation or erosion, affecting the style of the transformation.
optionDescriptions: Uses a circular (disk-shaped) structuring element for smooth, rounded transformations.
Uses a regular polygon as the structuring element, allowing for custom-sided shapes.
Uses a star or asterisk-shaped structuring element, emphasizing cross-like or radiating effects.
Uses a straight line as the structuring element, applying the effect directionally.
Uses a corner-shaped structuring element, targeting angular or edge features.

params.name: Vertices Count
params.description: For polygon shapes, sets the number of vertices (sides) used, controlling the regularity and appearance of the structuring element.

params.name: Corner Angle
params.description: Specifies the angle of the corner for the 'Corner' shape, adjusting the sharpness or openness of the structuring element.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Sets the orientation or direction for directional shapes (such as Line or Asterisk), controlling the angle of the effect.

params.name: Antialiased
params.description: If enabled, applies antialiasing to the aperture operation, smoothing the edges of the transformed features for a cleaner result.

nodes.name: Autolevel
nodes.description: Automatically remaps the input to use the full available height or mask range.

nodes.name: BlobRemover
nodes.description: BlobRemover can remove smaller fragments or blobs near larger shapes. This is very useful for cleanup.

params.name: Range
params.description: Controls the sensitivity of the blob detection. Higher values detect a wider range of blob sizes or intensities.

params.name: Connectivity
params.description: Specifies how connected blobs must be to be considered a single shape. Higher connectivity allows blobs to be more loosely attached to larger shapes.

params.name: Enforce Quantization
params.description: If enabled, forces the use of quantization during blob detection, improving efficiency and consistency in identifying blobs.

params.name: Quantization
params.description: Sets the quantization level for blob detection, with values between 1 and 128. Lower values provide finer detail, while higher values group similar values together for faster and more efficient blob identification.

nodes.name: Blur
nodes.description: Blur diffuses sharp shapes and softens the terrain.

nodes.name: Bomber
nodes.description: Bomber takes an input heightfield and "stamps" or bombs it across the entire terrain surface using the randomization properties you set.

params.name: Iterations
params.description: Number of instances the bombing operation will create. Higher values increase the number of scattered elements.

params.name: Multiplier
params.description: Quickly multiply the number of bombed instances by increasing or decreasing this value, scaling the overall density.

params.name: Size
params.description: The minimum and maximum relative size of bombed instances, allowing for variation in the scale of each element.

params.name: Size Distribution
params.description: Controls the uniformity of the size of bombed instances. Higher values produce more consistent sizes, while lower values allow greater variation.

params.name: Rotation
params.description: The minimum and maximum range of rotations for the bombed instances, introducing random orientation for each element.

params.name: Proportional
params.description: Determines whether instances should maintain height-to-size proportion. When enabled, scaling an instance will also scale its height proportionally.

params.name: Variable Height
params.description: Allows variations in the height of bombed instances, introducing additional randomness to their elevation.

params.name: Height
params.description: The minimum and maximum range of height variations for the bombed instances, controlling how tall or flat each element can be.

params.name: Distribution
params.description: The method used to distribute bombed instances across the surface.
optionDescriptions: A randomized distribution that results in pure chaotic patterns, scattering instances unpredictably.
A normalized grid distribution function that results in a systematic, evenly spaced pattern.

params.name: Jitter
params.description: The random offset applied to each instance while distributing, adding natural variation to their placement.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different distribution patterns.

params.name: Fade Edges
params.description: Softens the edges of bombed instances, blending them more smoothly into the base terrain.

params.name: Blend Mode
params.description: Specifies how the base terrain and bombed instances are merged together.
optionDescriptions: Each instance overwrites the underlying terrain at its location.
Blends instances with the base terrain using standard blending.
Adds the height values of instances on top of the base terrain.
Subtracts each instance from the base and previous instances, creating depressions.
Creates a difference between the base and each bombed instance, emphasizing changes.
Multiplies the base terrain with each bombed instance, modulating the result.
Adds the two inputs without overexposing the output, resulting in a lighter blend.
Retains the maximum height values of each bombed instance and the base terrain.
Retains the minimum height values of each bombed instance and the base terrain.

params.name: Quality
params.description: The level of quality to be used for the bombing operation. Draft is recommended for high-resolution previews, while Medium and High provide better final results.
optionDescriptions: Fastest processing with lower quality, suitable for previews.
Balanced quality and performance for general use.
Highest quality with the most detail, recommended for final output.

groupDetails.name: Add Input
groupDetails.description: Allows an additional input to be included in the bombing operation, enabling more complex or layered effects.

nodes.name: Bulbous
nodes.description: Bulbous inflates existing shapes to make them more voluminous while respecting standard geological boundaries.

nodes.name: Canyon
nodes.description: Canyon is a simple, fast, and detailed canyon primitive. It creates a drainage based river canyon.

params.name: Style
params.description: Selects the canyon shaping model used to generate the canyon form and surface character.
optionDescriptions: Clean, procedural canyon cuts with a simple, carved profile.
Adds erosion-like breakup and natural irregularities to the canyon walls and floor.
A more advanced eroded style with richer wall detail and more natural variation.
Introduces stratified, layered wall features resembling sedimentary rock bands.
Combines erosion breakup with stratified layering for a layered-and-worn look.

params.name: Scale
params.description: The scale of the canyon.

params.name: Slot
params.description: Controls the narrow, slot-canyon component - tightness and emphasis of the deepest cut.

params.name: Valley
params.description: Controls the broader valley form - overall widening and openness of the canyon.

params.name: Surrounding
params.description: Blends the canyon into the surrounding terrain, controlling how much the outer landform influences the final shape.

params.name: Depth
params.description: The depth of the canyon.

params.name: Structual Warp
params.description: Applies large-scale warping to the canyon structure to introduce bends, meanders, and macro variation.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

params.name: Detail Warp
params.description: Applies finer warping to add small-scale distortion and surface complexity without changing the overall canyon layout.

params.name: Alternate Style
params.description: Introduces a secondary variation of the selected style to break uniformity and add visual diversity.

groupDetails.name: Structure
groupDetails.description: Selects the canyon shaping model used to generate the canyon form and surface character.

groupDetails.name: Formation
groupDetails.description: Applies finer warping to add small-scale distortion and surface complexity without changing the overall canyon layout.

nodes.name: Cartography
nodes.description: Cartography creates a topographical overlay for a map.

params.name: Accuracy
params.description: Controls the precision of map features such as contours and gradients. Higher values produce more detailed and accurate representations of terrain.

params.name: Gradient Style
params.description: Specifies the style of gradient used to represent elevation or terrain features on the map.
optionDescriptions: Applies a continuous, smooth gradient for a natural transition between elevation bands.
Emphasizes major elevation bands with broad, distinct contour regions.
Displays all contour lines, including minor and major bands, for maximum detail.

params.name: Equalize Gradient
params.description: Balances the gradient distribution to ensure even representation of elevation changes across the map.

params.name: Reverse
params.description: Inverts the color or gradient mapping, swapping high and low elevation colors for a different visual effect.

params.name: Erode
params.description: Applies an erosion effect to the map, softening features and simulating natural terrain wear.

params.name: Land Palette
params.description: Selects the color palette used for land areas on the map.
optionDescriptions: Uses a traditional cartographic color scheme for land.
Applies a minimalistic color palette for a clean, modern look.
Highlights fertile areas with red tones.
Highlights fertile areas with green tones.
Uses a spectrum from red to blue to represent elevation or land type.
Emphasizes mineral-rich areas with yellow hues.
Applies cool tones to fertile regions for a subdued effect.
Uses murky, earthy tones to represent fertile land.

params.name: Land Contours
params.description: Controls the visibility and density of contour lines on land areas, highlighting elevation changes.

params.name: Land Contour Intenstity
params.description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of land contour lines, making them more or less prominent.

params.name: Land Bias
params.description: Applies a bias to the land color or contour mapping, shifting emphasis to certain elevation ranges or features.

params.name: Water Palette
params.description: Selects the color palette used for water areas on the map.
optionDescriptions: Uses a traditional blue color scheme for water.
Applies a dark, deep blue palette reminiscent of the Black Sea.
Uses bright, turquoise tones inspired by Caribbean waters.

params.name: Water Contours
params.description: Controls the visibility and density of contour lines in water areas, indicating depth or underwater features.

params.name: Water Contour Intenstity
params.description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of water contour lines, making them more or less prominent.

params.name: Water Bias
params.description: Applies a bias to the water color or contour mapping, shifting emphasis to certain depth ranges or features.

params.name: Trim
params.description: Removes or crops map features outside a specified boundary, focusing the map on a particular region.

params.name: Grid Count
params.description: Sets the number of grid divisions overlaid on the map, controlling the density of the grid.

params.name: Grid Intenstity
params.description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of the grid lines, making them more or less visible.

params.name: Grid Style
params.description: Specifies where grid lines are drawn on the map.
optionDescriptions: No grid lines are displayed.
Grid lines are drawn only over water areas.
Grid lines are drawn only over land areas.
Grid lines are drawn over both land and water areas.

params.name: Boundary Thickness
params.description: Sets the thickness of boundary lines, such as map borders or region outlines.

params.name: Contour Thickness
params.description: Specifies the thickness of contour lines, affecting their visual prominence.

params.name: Grid Thickness
params.description: Controls the thickness of grid lines overlaid on the map.

groupDetails.name: Map Style
groupDetails.description: Controls the precision of map features such as contours and gradients. Higher values produce more detailed and accurate representations of terrain.

groupDetails.name: Land
groupDetails.description: Selects the color palette used for land areas on the map.

groupDetails.name: Line Art
groupDetails.description: Sets the number of grid divisions overlaid on the map, controlling the density of the grid.

nodes.name: Cellular
nodes.description: Cellular creates cell-based patterns and noises that can be quite versatile as they're ever-present in nature.

params.name: Size
params.description: Controls the overall scale of the cellular pattern. Higher values produce smaller cells (finer detail); lower values produce larger cells (coarser detail).

params.name: Density
params.description: Controls how many feature points are generated per area. Higher density creates more, smaller cells; lower density creates fewer, larger cells.

params.name: Jitter
params.description: Randomizes feature-point placement. Low values are more uniform/structured; higher values create more organic, irregular cells.

params.name: Metric Morph
params.description: Blends between the paired distance behaviors implied by the selected Distance Metric (e.g., Euclidian ↔ Manhattan/Chebyshev), changing cell geometry continuously.

params.name: Distance Metric
params.description: Selects the distance-space used to evaluate the cellular field, affecting the fundamental shape of cells and borders.
optionDescriptions: Morph between rounded Euclidian cells and diamond-like Manhattan cells (axis-aligned, sharper corners) using Metric Morph.
Morph between rounded Euclidian cells and square-like Chebyshev cells using Metric Morph.
Generalized metric that spans a continuous family of distance shapes (useful for smoothly varying from rounded to more boxy forms).

params.name: Coordinate Axes Jitter
params.description: Adds jitter in coordinate/axis space before evaluation, warping the field and introducing directional wobble and boundary distortion.

params.name: CAJ Clustering
params.description: Controls how Coordinate Axes Jitter groups together. Low values spread distortion evenly; higher values create patchy/clumped distortion regions.

params.name: Anisotropy
params.description: Stretches the pattern directionally, producing elongated/elliptical cells and emphasizing a dominant direction.

params.name: Distance Function
params.description: Defines what value is output from the cellular field (cell IDs, distances to points, borders, or edges).
optionDescriptions: Outputs a stable random value per cell region (cell ID-style mask), useful for random patching, selection, and variation.
Outputs inverse distance to the nearest feature point (bright centers fading toward borders).
Outputs inverse distance to the second-nearest feature point, producing a different internal falloff useful for variation and breakup.
Outputs the difference between nearest distances (classic Voronoi edge emphasis), great for ridges, veins, and cell borders.
Outputs distance to the nearest cell border, ideal for crack networks and edge masks when remapped.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Changes the random distribution of feature points without changing other settings.

nodes.name: Cellular3D
nodes.description: Generates three-dimensional cellular noise useful for volumetric-looking patterns and complex terrain breakup.

params.name: Size
params.description: Controls the overall scale of the 3D cellular pattern. Higher values produce larger, more widely spaced cells.

params.name: Gap
params.description: Sets the distance or separation between individual cells, affecting the openness and density of the pattern.

params.name: Jitter X
params.description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the X axis, introducing irregularity and breaking uniformity.

params.name: Jitter Y
params.description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the Y axis, adding variation and natural randomness.

params.name: Jitter Z
params.description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the Z axis, further enhancing the organic appearance of the 3D pattern.

params.name: Scale X
params.description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the X axis, stretching or compressing cells horizontally.

params.name: Scale Y
params.description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the Y axis, stretching or compressing cells vertically.

params.name: Scale Z
params.description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the Z axis, stretching or compressing cells in depth.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the 3D cellular pattern. Changing the seed produces different cell arrangements.

params.name: Normalize Input
params.description: If enabled, normalizes the input values to a standard range before applying the cellular pattern, ensuring consistent results regardless of input scale.

nodes.name: Chokepoint
nodes.description: Chokepoint node is a special node whose sole purpose is to help avoid re-connecting many nodes, while adding no memory overhead.

nodes.name: Clamp
nodes.description: Clamp controls the height of the terrain. You can squash the terrain, clip it at certain heights, or make it taller using the Extend operation.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Specifies the clamping method used to restrict values within a certain range.
optionDescriptions: Applies a fixed minimum and maximum clamp to the input values, preserving their original scale.
Clamps and remaps the input values to a normalized 0–1 range, ensuring consistent output regardless of the original scale.

params.name: Value
params.description: Sets the clamp threshold or range. Values outside this range are limited to the specified minimum or maximum.

params.name: Drop
params.description: Lowers the overall shape to lowest value, ie 'dropping' the entire shape to the 'floor'.

nodes.name: Clip
nodes.description: Cuts the terrain against a threshold, removing values above or below a specified level.

nodes.name: CLUTer
nodes.description: CLUTer creates color gradients which can be mapped to texture masks to make color maps.

params.name: Reverse
params.description: Reverses the mapping of the gradient.

nodes.name: ColorErosion
nodes.description: Applies erosion-style transport and deposition to color data, creating more natural weathered color variation.

params.name: Version
optionDescriptions: <desc>
<desc>
<desc>

nodes.name: ColorThreshold
nodes.description: Creates a greyscale mask from a specified color range.

params.name: Start
params.description: The color to mask from the given input.

params.name: Falloff
params.description: Range of similar colors to be masked as well.

nodes.name: Combine
nodes.description: Combine is one of Gaea's most important nodes. You can combine two terrains (or any node output) using various mathematical operations often known as Blend Modes.

params.name: Ratio
params.description: The ratio applied to the selected method.

params.name: Mode
optionDescriptions:
Simply overlays the source on top of the base without extra math.
Direct normal blend; top layer replaces base with alpha control.

Brightens by adding the source to the base.
Linear addition of source and base channels, clamped at max.

Lightens by blending as if projected on a screen.
Inverts both, multiplies, then inverts; 1 - (1 - A) × (1 - B).

Darkens by subtracting the source from the base.
Base minus source per channel, clamps at zero.

Emphasizes contrast by subtracting lower from higher values.
Absolute difference |A - B| for high-contrast edge-like results.

Darkens by multiplying source and base colors.
Channel-wise multiplication; A × B, darkens with stacking.

Lightens by dividing base by source.
Base divided by source; A / B with normalization/scaling.

Alternative division with different scaling for smoother results.
Alternate divide with different scaling/offset to reduce clipping.

Keeps the brighter value at each pixel.
Channel-wise maximum; keeps highest of A and B.

Keeps the darker value at each pixel.
Channel-wise minimum; keeps lowest of A and B.

Combines channels using geometric distance for soft blending.
sqrt(A² + B²); Euclidean combination for smooth, bright blend.

Combines multiply and screen for vivid contrast.
Combines Multiply and Screen based on base brightness.

Raises base to the power of source for nonlinear effects.
Raises base to source power; A ^ B per channel.

Low-contrast version of Difference for softer inversion.
A + B - 2AB; softer Difference with reduced contrast.

Brightens highlights by dividing inverted base by inverted source.
A / (1 - B); brightens highlights aggressively.

Darkens shadows by inverting, dividing, and inverting again.
1 - (1 - A) / B; intensifies shadows via division.

Gently lightens or darkens based on source brightness.
Conditional blend approximating diffused light on surface.

Strong contrast blend combining multiply and screen.
Screen or Multiply based on source brightness threshold.

Replaces pixels selectively with lighter or darker values.
Replaces mid-range with source; keeps extremes from base.

Adds source to base with mid-gray treated as transparent.
A + B - 0.5; mid-gray = no change; good for texture merge.

Subtracts source from base, centering results on mid-gray.
A - B + 0.5; isolates texture/detail difference.

Creates intense highlights by reflecting colors around white.
A² / (1 - B); creates sharp highlight 'reflection' effects.

Emphasizes bright regions for a glowing effect.
Inverse Dodge-like; emphasizes light bloom by brightening source areas.

Produces a fiery inversion by subtracting and swapping values.
A - B + max(A, B); surreal color inversions with swap-like logic.

params.name: Output
params.description: How to process the data range.
optionDescriptions: Retain pure, unclamped data. Less safer, but useful in advanced usage.
Clamp the data to 0..1 range. Slightly slower, but recommended for safety.
Extend to fill the range.

params.name: Enhance
params.description: Post-process the output.
optionDescriptions: No post-processing. Recommended.
Autolevel the output.
Equalize the output.

groupDetails.name: Swap Inputs
groupDetails.description: Switches the two inputs.

nodes.name: Compare
nodes.description: Compares two inputs and produces a result based on their relative values.

params.name: A/B
params.description: Ratio of the terrain to compare.

params.name: Colorized
params.description: Show colorized output to signify the modified terrain.

params.name: Perpendicular
params.description: Switch from Horizontal/Stacked to Perpendicular comparison.

params.name: Swap
params.description: Swap A and B inputs.

nodes.name: Cone
nodes.description: Generates a simple conical gradient that is useful as a primitive shape or mask.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size (radius) of the cone.

params.name: Height
params.description: Controls the height (amplitude) of the cone.

params.name: X
params.description: Offsets the cone’s center along the X axis.

params.name: Y
params.description: Offsets the cone’s center along the Y axis.

nodes.name: Constant
nodes.description: Constant creates a blank terrain of the height specified, or a flat color output.

params.name: Output
params.description: The type of output to create.
optionDescriptions: Create a flat terrain of the specified height.
Create a flat color output of the specified color.

params.name: Height
params.description: The height of the blank terrain.

params.name: Color
params.description: The color to use for creating a flat, color output.

groupDetails.name: Constant
groupDetails.description: The type of output to create.

nodes.name: Contours
nodes.description: Creates map-like contours for a terrain. Useful for making maps or for other overlays.

params.name: Count
params.description: Sets the number of main contour lines to generate. Higher values create more elevation bands across the terrain.

params.name: Subdivision
params.description: Controls the number of subdivisions between main contour lines, adding finer detail and intermediate lines.

params.name: Accuracy
params.description: Adjusts the precision of contour line placement. Higher accuracy produces more exact lines that closely follow the terrain's elevation.

params.name: Line Intensity
params.description: Controls the brightness or opacity of the main contour lines, making them more or less prominent in the output.

params.name: Sub Intensity
params.description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of the subdivision lines, which are the finer lines between main contours.

params.name: Line Thickness
params.description: Specifies the thickness of the contour lines. Higher values produce bolder, wider lines.

groupDetails.name: Lines
groupDetails.description: Controls the brightness or opacity of the main contour lines, making them more or less prominent in the output.

nodes.name: Cracks
nodes.description: Cracks primitive creates large, cracked patterns on a flat base.

params.name: Style
params.description: The style of the crack pattern generated by the node.
optionDescriptions: The default style that creates cracks that gentle slope inward.
The edges of the cracks are not refined and may show aliasing. This may be useful if the softer edges create artifacts in other nodes.
The default style from previous versions of Gaea. This is creates very thin cracks without a slope curve.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: The number of crack pattern sets to generate.

params.name: Scale
params.description: The overall size of the cracked pattern.

params.name: Depth
params.description: The depth of the cracks. It also widens the cracks.

params.name: Jitter
params.description: Control the offset of the cracks between symmetrical and chaotic.

params.name: Warp Strength
params.description: The strength of the warp distortion applied to the cracks.

params.name: Warp Size
params.description: The size of the warp distortion applied to the cracks.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

params.name: Scale X
params.description: The non-uniform scale on the X axis.

params.name: Scale Y
params.description: The non-uniform scale on the Y axis.

groupDetails.name: Cracks
groupDetails.description: The style of the crack pattern generated by the node.

groupDetails.name: Advanced settings
groupDetails.description: The non-uniform scale on the X axis.

nodes.name: Craggy
nodes.description: Turns a terrain's surface into a craggy, rocky, broken landscape.

params.name: Size
params.description: Controls the overall scale of the craggy features. Higher values produce larger cracked rock formations on the surface.

params.name: Depth
params.description: Sets the depth or prominence of the cracks and rock features, determining how pronounced the craggy shapes appear.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Defines the overall form and pattern of the cracked rock shapes, affecting their outline and distribution.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the craggy rock patterns. Changing the seed produces different results.

nodes.name: Crater
nodes.description: Crater primitive creates different types of crater shapes.

params.name: Style
params.description: Selects the overall appearance and shaping method for the crater.
optionDescriptions: Uses the modern crater generation algorithm, producing more realistic and detailed crater shapes.
Applies the legacy crater style, creating traditional, stylized crater forms.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size of the crater. Higher values produce larger craters.

params.name: Formation
params.description: Determines the formation characteristics of the crater, such as depth, width, and rim prominence.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum elevation or prominence of the crater above the base terrain.

params.name: Rim
params.description: Specifies the sharpness and profile of the crater's rim.

nodes.name: Crumble
nodes.description: Crumble runs a different kind of simulation that feeds off of existing crevices, erosive information, and other subtle details to collapse the terrain. Just as the name implies, the terrain starts crumbling from the edges.

params.name: Duration
params.description: Controls how long the simulation runs. Longer durations produce stronger and more extensive crumbling effects.

params.name: Strength
params.description: Defines how intensely the rock or terrain breaks apart from the main body. Higher values result in more aggressive fragmentation.

params.name: Coverage
params.description: Sets how far the crumbling effect spreads inward from exposed edges, determining the affected area.

params.name: Horizontal
params.description: Biases the crumble effect towards flow origins or towards deposits, influencing the lateral direction of collapse.

params.name: Vertical
params.description: Biases the crumble effect towards higher or lower altitudes, controlling whether upper or lower terrain is more affected.

params.name: Rock Hardness
params.description: Controls material resistance, reducing how much terrain collapses. Higher values simulate harder, more resilient rock.

params.name: Edge
params.description: Expands or reduces the impact of crumbling specifically on sharp terrain edges, allowing for more pronounced or subdued edge effects.

params.name: Downcutting
params.description: Controls how deeply the simulation carves downward into the terrain during crumbling, affecting the vertical extent of collapse.

params.name: Depth
params.description: Adjusts the overall depth of the collapsed areas, determining how far the terrain sinks or breaks away.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Specifies the primary direction in which the crumbling effect propagates across the terrain.
optionDescriptions: Directs the crumbling effect along the X (horizontal) axis.
Directs the crumbling effect towards the north (upward in world space).
Directs the crumbling effect towards the east (right in world space).
Directs the crumbling effect towards the south (downward in world space).
Directs the crumbling effect towards the west (left in world space).

nodes.name: Curvature
nodes.description: Curvature creates a mask where convex areas (protrusions, sharp edges, etc.) are selected. Very useful layer in texture creation, often as highlights on top of an existing texture map.

params.name: Range
params.description: Sets the minimum and maximum curvature values to include in the mask. Only terrain features within this curvature range are selected.

params.name: Type
params.description: Specifies the type of curvature to evaluate for the mask, determining which terrain features are highlighted.
optionDescriptions: Selects areas with horizontal (planform) curvature, highlighting ridges and valleys based on their plan shape.
Selects areas with vertical (profile) curvature, emphasizing convex and concave slopes along the direction of steepest descent.
Uses the average of horizontal and vertical curvature, providing a balanced mask that highlights both plan and profile features.

params.name: Falloff
params.description: Controls the softness of the mask transition at the range boundaries. Higher values create a smoother, more gradual blend from selected to unselected areas.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Specifies how the curve is applied to the input values.

groupDetails.name: Curve Spline

groupDetails.name: Fit Curve

params.name: Restitution

params.name: Passes

params.description: Sets the size of the dilation effect. Larger values expand features more, increasing the reach of the dilation.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Specifies the geometric shape used for the dilation operation, affecting how features are expanded.

params.name: Iterations
params.description: Controls how many times the dilation process is repeated. More iterations result in greater expansion of features.

nodes.name: Distance
nodes.description: Generates a distance field from the input, measuring how far each point is from the nearest boundary or feature.

params.name: Method
params.description: Specifies the algorithm used to calculate distance. Different methods may offer varying performance or accuracy.
optionDescriptions: Uses the standard distance calculation method, suitable for most general purposes.
Uses a real-time optimized distance calculation, providing faster results for interactive workflows.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Determines the pattern or structure of the distance calculation, affecting how distance propagates from the source.
optionDescriptions: Calculates distance in a star-shaped (asterisk) pattern, radiating out in multiple directions.
Calculates distance in a pyramid or diamond pattern, emphasizing diagonal and orthogonal propagation.

params.name: Directions
params.description: Sets the number of directions in which distance is calculated, influencing the angular resolution and smoothness of the result.

params.name: Skew
params.description: Applies a skew or bias to the distance field, distorting the propagation direction for creative or technical effects.

params.name: Angle

params.name: Angular Jitter
params.description: Introduces randomness to the angle of distance propagation, creating more organic and less uniform distance fields.

params.name: Falloff
params.description: Controls how quickly the distance value decreases with increasing distance from the source, shaping the gradient of the field.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: Sets a cutoff value for the distance field. Values beyond this threshold are clamped or ignored.

params.name: Falloff Jitter
params.description: Adds randomness to the falloff rate, producing irregular or natural-looking distance gradients.

params.name: Invert Input
params.description: Inverts the input mask or field before calculating distance, reversing the source and background.

params.name: Invert Output
params.description: Inverts the resulting distance field, swapping near and far values.

params.name: Multiply by Input
params.description: Multiplies the final distance field by the original input, masking or modulating the result.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for any stochastic elements in the distance calculation, ensuring reproducible or varied results.

params.name: Iterations
params.description: Sets the number of times dots or blobs are placed on the surface. Higher values increase the density and coverage of the noise.

params.name: Multiplier
params.description: Scales the intensity or strength of the dot noise effect, amplifying the contribution of each blob.

params.name: Size

params.name: Height

params.name: Blend Mode
params.description: Determines how the dot noise is combined with the underlying surface or input.

nodes.name: Erosion
nodes.description: Erosion is the cornerstone of all terrains. It simulates hydraulic erosion and turns any shape into a realistic-looking terrain.

params.name: Duration
params.description: Determines the duration of the erosion simulation. Higher values increase the overall erosion effect, while lower values add subtle erosion details and preserve more of the original landscape.

params.name: Rock Softness
params.description: Controls the softness of the rock material. Softer rocks erode more quickly, resulting in faster and more pronounced erosion.

params.name: Strength
params.description: Sets the strength of fluvial erosion, controlling the sediment transport capacity. Higher values allow water to carry more dissolved minerals, increasing the rate and impact of erosion.

params.name: Downcutting
params.description: Group containing parameters related to the vertical erosion process, where water cuts down into the terrain to form channels and valleys.

params.name: Inhibition
params.description: Adds restraints to the downcutting process by slowing it down when undissolved sediments accumulate. This results in a mix of deep channels and alluvial fans, depending on local conditions.

params.name: Base Level
params.description: Sets the lowest elevation that downcutting can reach before sediment is deposited. This helps fill large valleys and form valley floors, influenced by terrain slope, altitude, and stream velocity.

params.name: Feature Scale
params.description: Determines the lateral size of the largest erosion features, such as the width of major valleys and ridges, measured in meters.

params.name: Real Scale
params.description: Automatically determines the scale from the Terrain Definition, ensuring erosion features are sized appropriately for the terrain.

params.name: Terrain Scale
params.description: Sets the simulated scale of the entire terrain width. Available when Rivers is enabled, this parameter helps match erosion to real-world dimensions.

params.name: Verticality
params.description: Sets the simulated height of the entire terrain. Available when Rivers is enabled, this parameter controls the vertical exaggeration of erosion features.

params.name: Debris
params.description: Controls the amount and behavior of debris generated and transported during the erosion process.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Alters erosion physics to treat water flows as volumetric, resulting in higher water levels, wider channels, and more extensive sediment deposits. Useful for forming valley floors without downcutting.

params.name: Sediment Removal
params.description: Removes sediment produced during erosion. This can be modulated using the Sediment Removal mask input to control where sediment is retained or cleared.

params.name: Area Effect
params.description: Specifies the effect applied when an Area input or Bias is defined. Determines which erosion property is selectively processed.
optionDescriptions: Applies selective processing to the erosion strength, allowing targeted control over erosion intensity.
Applies selective processing to rock softness, enabling localized variation in erosion rates.
Applies selective processing to precipitation amount, affecting how much water is available for erosion in specific areas.
No selective processing is applied; erosion is uniform across the terrain.

params.name: Bias Type
params.description: Specifies the type of automatic bias to apply when an Area input is not provided. Determines how erosion is distributed based on terrain features.
optionDescriptions: Applies bias based on elevation, allowing erosion to be stronger or weaker at different heights.
Applies bias based on terrain slope, enabling more erosion on steeper or flatter areas.

params.name: Bias
params.description: Sets the strength of the bias. For Slope, this controls the steepness threshold; for Altitude, it sets the position from the bottom of the terrain.

params.name: Reverse
params.description: Reverses the direction of the bias, inverting which areas receive more or less erosion.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for the erosion process. Changing the seed produces different erosion patterns and channel arrangements.

params.name: Aggressive Mode
params.description: Enables faster erosion processing at the risk of introducing soft artifacts in minor areas. Useful for quick previews or when speed is prioritized over detail.

params.name: Deterministic
params.description: Ensures the erosion simulation produces the same result every time with the same input and seed, improving reproducibility.

params.name: Mode

Keeps fine detail and removes broad, low-frequency forms.

params.name: Gain

params.name: Q
params.description: Filter sharpness/bandwidth (higher Q = narrower, more selective band; lower Q = broader influence).

params.description: Preserves the overall baseline/average height (DC offset) so the filter affects detail without shifting the mean elevation.

nodes.name: Flip
nodes.description: Flip flips the terrain horizontally, vertically, or both.

params.name: Type
params.description: Selects which axis the input is mirrored across.
optionDescriptions: Flips the input horizontally (mirrors along the X axis).
Flips the input vertically (mirrors along the Y axis).
Flips both axes (180° mirror of the input).

nodes.name: FlowMap
nodes.description: Generates a modern flow map showing how water or material would travel across the terrain.

params.name: Flow Length
params.description: Controls how far flow paths are traced across the surface (longer values produce longer streams/flow lines).

params.name: Flow Volume
params.description: Controls the amount/strength of flow accumulation used to form the flow map (higher values emphasize major channels).

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

nodes.name: Fold
nodes.description: Fold simulates terrain folding by introducing slants, breaks, and folds to the terrain. It significantly changes the terrain shape and should be used early in the graph.

params.name: Waveform
params.description: Specifies the type of waveform used to apply the fold or wave transformation to the terrain. The waveform determines the shape and style of the folds.
optionDescriptions: Applies a smooth, sinusoidal wave pattern, creating gentle, rolling folds.
Applies a triangular wave pattern, resulting in sharp, angular folds with linear transitions.
Applies a sawtooth wave pattern, producing repeating, ramp-like folds with abrupt drops.

params.name: Folds
params.description: Controls the number of folds or wave repetitions applied across the terrain. Higher values create more frequent, closely spaced folds.

params.name: Symmetric
params.description: Determines whether the folds are mirrored symmetrically across the center, producing balanced, repeating patterns.

nodes.name: FractalTerraces
nodes.description: FractalTerraces creates fractal terracing on the terrain. It is a powerful alternative to the Terrace node.

params.name: Spacing
params.description: Sets the space between two terraces. Controls the horizontal distance or interval between each terrace step.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: Specifies the number of terraces to generate, including subtle sub-terraces. Higher values create more layers and finer detail.

params.name: Intensity
params.description: Controls the strength of the terracing process. Higher intensities flatten the terraces, making the steps more pronounced.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Defines the general shape of the terraces. Lower values create steeper terraces that follow the terrain's bulk, while higher values produce smoother terraces that protrude outward.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different terrace arrangements.

params.name: Shapes separation
params.description: Controls how distinctly individual terrace shapes are separated from each other, affecting the clarity of terrace boundaries.

params.name: Macro octaves
params.description: Sets the number of large-scale terrace layers, influencing the overall structure and major steps in the terrain.

params.name: Micro shape
params.description: Adjusts the fine detail and small-scale shaping of terraces, adding subtle variations to each step.

params.name: Character
params.description: Modifies the overall character or style of the terraces, such as their ruggedness or smoothness.

params.name: Thickness uniformity
params.description: Controls how consistent the thickness of each terrace step is across the terrain. Higher values produce more uniform terraces.

params.name: Hardness uniformity
params.description: Adjusts the consistency of terrace edge hardness, affecting whether terrace boundaries are sharp or soft throughout.

params.name: Strata details
params.description: Adds additional detail to the strata or layers within the terraces, enhancing geological realism.

params.name: Protect Range
params.description: Defines a range within which the original terrain is protected from terracing, preserving natural features in specified areas.

params.name: Apply Tilt
params.description: Enables or disables the tilt effect, allowing terraces to be slanted in a specified direction.

params.name: Tilt Amount
params.description: Sets the degree of tilt applied to the terraces, controlling how steeply they are angled.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Specifies the direction in which the tilt is applied, determining the orientation of the slant.

params.name: Tilt Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for the tilt effect, producing varied tilt patterns when changed.

params.name: Warp Amount
params.description: Controls the strength of the warp effect applied to the terraces, introducing distortion and organic variation.

params.name: Warp Size
params.description: Sets the scale of the warp effect, determining how broad or fine the distortion is.

params.name: Warp Style
params.description: Specifies the style of warping applied to the terraces, affecting the nature of the distortion.

nodes.name: Gabor
nodes.description: Gabor noise is one of the lesser used noises, but provides a wonderful pattern-friendly noise that can be used to simulate various aspects of nature.

params.name: Size
params.description: Controls the scale of the Gabor noise features. Larger values produce broader, more widely spaced patterns, while smaller values create finer details.

params.name: Entropy
params.description: Adjusts the randomness or complexity of the Gabor noise. Higher entropy values result in more chaotic and less predictable patterns.

params.name: Anisotropy
params.description: Determines the degree of directionality in the noise. Higher values stretch the pattern along a specific axis, creating elongated or striated features.

params.name: Azimuth
params.description: Sets the orientation angle (in degrees) for the anisotropic direction of the Gabor noise, controlling the alignment of elongated features.

params.name: Gain
params.description: Controls the amplitude or intensity of the Gabor noise, affecting the contrast and prominence of the generated features.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different variations of the Gabor noise.

groupDetails.name: Gabor
groupDetails.description: Controls the scale of the Gabor noise features. Larger values produce broader, more widely spaced patterns, while smaller values create finer details.

nodes.name: Gamma
nodes.description: Gamma applies Gamma adjustment to the heightfield, working exactly like Gamma in an image processing program.

params.name: Gamma
params.description:
The Gamma range is 0.0 to 2.5, with 1.0 being neutral or the original incoming gamma.
< 1.0 lifts mid-values (brighter), expands lighter detail, broadens features.
> 1.0 darkens mid-values, compresses lighter detail, tightens features.

params.name: Automatic
params.description: Tries to automatically set the correct gamma based on existing value.

nodes.name: Gate
nodes.description: Defines a baking boundary for the graph by forcing all ancestor nodes to be baked.

nodes.name: Glacier
nodes.description: Glacier creates flowing glaciers on mountain tops.

nodes.name: GraphicEQ
nodes.description: Reshapes terrain using multiple adjustable bands, similar to an equalizer for height profiles.

nodes.name: Grid
nodes.description: Generates a regular grid pattern useful for cartography, masking, or stylized surfaces.

params.name: Subdivision
params.description: Sets the number of grid divisions along each axis. Higher values create a denser grid with more cells.

params.name: Line Intensity
params.description: Controls the brightness or opacity of the main grid lines, making them more or less prominent in the texture.

params.name: Sub Intensity
params.description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of the subdivision lines, which are the finer lines between main grid lines.

params.name: Line Thickness
params.description: Specifies the thickness of the grid lines. Higher values produce bolder, wider lines.

nodes.name: GroundTexture
nodes.description: GroundTexture adds superficial detail to the terrain to increase realism.

params.name: Method
params.description: Specifies the style of ground texture to generate, affecting the overall appearance and character of the surface.
optionDescriptions: Creates a ground texture with strong, pronounced features and high contrast, simulating rugged or eroded terrain.
Generates a texture with rocky details, emphasizing stone-like patterns and roughness typical of stony ground.
Produces a generally uneven and coarse texture, adding subtle irregularities for a natural, weathered look.

params.name: Strength
params.description: Controls the intensity of the ground texture effect. Higher values make the texture more prominent and detailed.

params.name: Coverage
params.description: Adjusts how much of the terrain surface is affected by the ground texture, determining the extent of the effect.

params.name: Density
params.description: Sets the concentration of texture features across the surface. Higher density results in more frequent and closely packed details.

nodes.name: Halftone
nodes.description: Converts the terrain or mask into a halftone-style rendered output.

params.name: Pattern
params.description: Specifies the halftone pattern or dithering algorithm used to convert a black and white map into halftone shading. Each pattern produces a distinct visual effect, simulating various print or screen halftone styles.
optionDescriptions: Applies Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion dithering, producing a classic, high-quality halftone effect with smooth gradients.
Uses Riemersma dithering, which distributes error along a space-filling curve for a unique, less directional halftone appearance.
Uses a 2x2 ordered dithering matrix to create a small, repeating halftone pattern.
Uses a 3x3 ordered dithering matrix for a slightly larger, repeating halftone pattern.
Uses a 4x4 ordered dithering matrix, producing a more detailed and less repetitive halftone effect.
Applies an 8x8 ordered dithering matrix for fine, detailed halftone shading with minimal visible repetition.
Uses a 6x6 halftone matrix (variant A) for a larger, more complex dot pattern.
Applies an 8x8 halftone matrix (variant A), generating a dense and detailed halftone texture.
Applies a 6x6 halftone matrix (variant O), producing a unique halftone pattern with distinct dot placement.
Uses an 8x8 halftone matrix (variant O), providing a dense and alternative halftone style.
Uses a 5x5 circular halftone matrix with black dots, simulating traditional print halftone screens.
Uses a 5x5 circular halftone matrix with white dots, inverting the typical halftone dot style.
Applies a 6x6 circular halftone matrix with black dots for a slightly larger dot pattern.
Uses a 6x6 circular halftone matrix with white dots, providing an inverted halftone effect.
Applies a 7x7 circular halftone matrix with black dots, creating a larger, more pronounced dot pattern.
Uses a 7x7 circular halftone matrix with white dots, offering a bold, inverted halftone style.

nodes.name: Heal
nodes.description: Heal reconstructs damaged, low res, or 8-bit data with 16-bit, high resolution fidelity. It cleans up quantized images with extreme banding of any shape, and yields naturalistic terrain output.

params.name: Reconstruction
params.description: Controls how aggressively missing or damaged areas are rebuilt from surrounding data (higher values preserve continuity but can soften detail).

params.name: Passes
params.description: Number of healing iterations to run; more passes produce a cleaner, more continuous surface but may blur fine detail.

nodes.name: Height
nodes.description: Height creates a selection mask within the height range specified.

params.name: Range
params.description: Sets the minimum and maximum elevation values to include in the mask. Only terrain within this height range is selected.

params.name: Falloff
params.description: Controls the softness of the mask transition at the range boundaries. Higher values create a smoother, more gradual blend from selected to unselected areas.

nodes.name: Hemisphere
nodes.description: Generates a hemispherical gradient useful for domes, mounds, and radial falloffs.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size of the hemisphere. Larger values increase the radius and footprint of the shape on the terrain.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum elevation of the hemisphere, determining how tall the dome rises above the base level.

params.name: X
params.description: Adjusts the horizontal position of the hemisphere along the X axis, allowing you to move it left or right within the terrain.

params.name: Y
params.description: Adjusts the horizontal position of the hemisphere along the Y axis, allowing you to move it forward or backward within the terrain.

params.name: Flatten
params.description: Flattens the top of the hemisphere, creating a dome with a plateau or truncated appearance instead of a perfect curve.

nodes.name: Hillify
nodes.description: Softens and reshapes terrain into smoother, hill-like forms.

nodes.name: HSL
nodes.description: Adjusts the hue, saturation, and lightness of a color input.

params.name: Hue
params.description: Adjusts the hue of the input, shifting colors around the color wheel. Changing this value alters the overall color tone.

params.name: Saturation
params.description: Controls the intensity or vividness of colors. Higher values produce more vibrant colors, while lower values result in muted or grayscale tones.

params.name: Lightness
params.description: Sets the brightness of the colors. Increasing lightness makes the image lighter, while decreasing it darkens the image.

nodes.name: HydroFix
nodes.description: HydroFix alters the terrain to create continuous drainage network friendly slopes. It can be used before Erosion or other flow related nodes to get better results.

params.name: Downcutting
params.description: The amount of downcutting to apply while modifying the terrain for hydrological flow.

groupDetails.name: HydroFix
groupDetails.description: The amount of downcutting to apply while modifying the terrain for hydrological flow.

nodes.name: IceFloe
nodes.description: Icefloe creates flat plates of ice inside a water body.

params.name: Size
params.description: Controls the overall scale of the ice floes. Higher values produce larger ice sheets or floes across the terrain.

params.name: Density
params.description: Adjusts how many ice floes are distributed across the surface. Higher values increase the number of floes per area.

params.name: Layers
params.description: Sets the number of distinct ice layers, allowing for multi-layered ice formations and increased visual complexity.

params.name: Thickness
params.description: Specifies the vertical thickness of the ice floes, determining how prominent or deep the ice appears.

params.name: Shaper 1
params.description: Applies the first shaping function or modifier to the ice floes, affecting their outline and internal structure.

params.name: Shaper 2
params.description: Applies a secondary shaping function or modifier, allowing for additional variation and detail in the ice floes.

params.name: Reverse
params.description: Inverts the effect of the primary shaping function, altering the distribution or orientation of the ice floes.

params.name: Reverse 2
params.description: Inverts the effect of the secondary shaping function, providing further control over the appearance of the ice floes.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different ice floe arrangements.

nodes.name: Island
nodes.description: Island draws basic shapes from which entire landmasses can be generated.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

nodes.name: Lake
nodes.description: Lake simulates rainfall on the terrain and creates physically accurate lakes.

optionDescriptions: <desc>

params.name: Y

params.description: Level of the water.

params.name: Render Surface
params.description: Whether to render the surface of the water or just create masks.

params.name: Accuracy
params.description: The accuracy of the water placement and water containment within depressions.

params.name: Precipitation
params.description: Controls the amount of water available for lake formation, influencing the size and number of lakes generated.

params.name: Small Lakes
params.description: Enables or adjusts the creation of smaller lakes, increasing the frequency of minor water bodies across the terrain.

params.name: Flood Control
params.description: Limits excessive flooding by managing water distribution, preventing lakes from overflowing or merging unnaturally.

params.name: Water Floor
params.description: Sets the elevation of the lake bed, determining the minimum depth and base level of the water body.

params.name: Shore Size
params.description: Controls the width and extent of the shoreline around lakes, affecting how far the shore transitions into the surrounding terrain.

params.name: Altitude Bias
params.description: Biases lake placement towards certain altitudes, favoring higher or lower terrain for lake formation.

params.name: Size Bias
params.description: Adjusts the likelihood of generating larger or smaller lakes, influencing the overall distribution of lake sizes.

groupDetails.name: Lake Formation

groupDetails.name: Shore Formation

nodes.name: Layers
nodes.description: Combines multiple layers using blend operations in a stacked workflow.

nodes.name: Lichtenberg
nodes.description: Creates branching, lightning-like erosion or fracture patterns.

params.name: Style
params.description: Selects the style for the cracks, determining the overall appearance and pattern of the Lichtenberg figures.
optionDescriptions: Style A: Produces a classic branching crack pattern, suitable for general terrain fracturing.
Style B: Generates a denser, more intricate crack network for detailed surface effects.
Style C: Creates a sparse, wide-spread crack pattern, ideal for subtle terrain disruption.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the scale of the larger cracks, affecting how prominent and wide the main crack structures appear.

params.name: Complexity
params.description: Adjusts the level of detail in the crack network. Higher values produce more branches and finer crack structures.

params.name: Depth
params.description: Sets the depth of the cracks, determining how deeply the cracks cut into the terrain surface.

params.name: Expand
params.description: Expands the cracks outward, increasing their coverage and making the crack network more pronounced.

params.name: Bias
params.description: Provides artistic control over the shape and direction of the cracks, allowing for customized crack patterns.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Random seed for generating the crack pattern. Changing the seed produces different crack arrangements while keeping other settings the same.

nodes.name: LightX
nodes.description: Creates a fully lit render using controllable sun, shadow, and ambient lighting.

params.name: Direction Selection
params.description: Specifies how the sun direction is determined for lighting calculations.
optionDescriptions: Allows manual input of sun direction parameters such as azimuth and elevation.
Calculates sun direction based on geographic coordinates, date, and time for physically accurate lighting.

params.name: North
params.description: Sets the orientation of the north direction in the scene, affecting geographic sun calculations.

params.name: Latitude
params.description: Specifies the latitude for geographic sun calculations, influencing sun position and lighting angle.

params.name: Day of Year
params.description: Sets the day of the year for geographic sun calculations, affecting seasonal sun position and lighting.

params.name: Solar Hour
params.description: Specifies the time of day for geographic sun calculations, determining the sun's position in the sky.

params.name: Sun Azimuth
params.description: Sets the horizontal angle of the sun, determining the direction from which sunlight is cast.

params.name: Sun Elevation
params.description: Controls the vertical angle of the sun above the horizon, affecting the length and intensity of shadows.

params.name: Angular Diameter
params.description: Specifies the apparent size of the sun in the sky, influencing the softness of shadows and highlights.

params.name: Direct Light
params.description: Adjusts the intensity of direct sunlight in the scene, affecting brightness and shadow contrast.

params.name: Shadows
params.description: Enables or adjusts the rendering of shadows cast by terrain features, enhancing depth and realism.

params.name: Ambient Light
params.description: Controls the overall ambient light level, simulating indirect illumination from the sky and environment.

params.name: Ambient Occlusion
params.description: Enables or adjusts ambient occlusion, which darkens crevices and areas shielded from ambient light for added realism.

params.name: Quality
params.description: Sets the rendering quality for lighting and shadow calculations.
optionDescriptions: Fastest rendering with basic lighting and shadow detail.
Balanced quality and performance with moderate lighting and shadow detail.
High-quality rendering with detailed lighting and shadows.
Maximum quality with the most accurate lighting and shadow effects.

params.name: Exposure
params.description: Adjusts the exposure level, controlling the overall brightness and dynamic range of the rendered image.

params.name: Sun Intensity
params.description: Sets the strength of the sun's light, affecting the brightness of direct illumination.

params.name: Ambient Intensity
params.description: Controls the strength of ambient light, influencing the brightness of areas not directly lit by the sun.

params.name: Air Density
params.description: Simulates atmospheric density, affecting the scattering of light and the appearance of haze.

params.name: Haze
params.description: Adds atmospheric haze to the scene, softening distant terrain and simulating light diffusion.

params.name: Ozone
params.description: Adjusts the ozone level in the atmosphere, influencing the color and intensity of sunlight.

params.name: Automatic Colors
params.description: Enables automatic adjustment of sun and ambient colors based on sun position and atmospheric conditions.

params.name: Sun Color
params.description: Sets the color of direct sunlight, allowing for warm, cool, or custom lighting effects.

params.name: Ambient Color
params.description: Specifies the color of ambient light, affecting the overall tone of shaded areas.

params.name: Ground Brightness
params.description: Controls the brightness of the ground plane, influencing the overall illumination and visual balance of the scene.

groupDetails.name: Light
groupDetails.description: Adjusts the exposure level, controlling the overall brightness and dynamic range of the rendered image.

groupDetails.name: Colors

nodes.name: Match

params.name: Mode
params.description: Specifies the method used to match the height of the current terrain to a reference terrain. Determines how the height adjustment is performed.
optionDescriptions: Directly matches the height values of the current terrain to the reference terrain, aligning elevation point-for-point.
Matches the height distribution (histogram) of the current terrain to that of the reference terrain, preserving relative features while adjusting overall elevation statistics.
