nodes.name: Mesher
nodes.description: Mesher can save specific nodes as meshes instead of heightfields, and can also generate LODs.

params.name: Format
params.description: Specifies the file format for the exported mesh. Choose the format that best fits your workflow or target application.
optionDescriptions: Exports the mesh in the standard OBJ format, widely supported for 3D models and compatible with most 3D software.
Exports the mesh in the FBX format, suitable for advanced workflows and supporting animation, hierarchy, and metadata.
Exports the mesh in the Collada (DAE) format, an open standard for exchanging 3D assets between applications.
Exports the mesh in the glTF format, optimized for real-time rendering and web-based 3D applications.
Exports the mesh in the binary GLB format, a compact version of glTF for efficient storage and transmission.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Sets the unit or normalization method for the exported mesh coordinates, determining how the model's size is interpreted.
optionDescriptions: Exports the mesh with coordinates normalized to a 0–1 range, useful for workflows that require unitless or relative positions.
Exports the mesh with coordinates in meters, matching real-world scale for compatibility with engineering and GIS applications.
Exports the mesh with coordinates in kilometers, suitable for large-scale terrain or geospatial datasets.

params.name: Topology
params.description: Specifies the type of mesh topology used for the exported model, affecting how the surface is constructed and rendered.
optionDescriptions: Generates the mesh using triangles for all faces, ensuring compatibility with all 3D engines and applications.
Generates the mesh using quadrilaterals where possible, preferred for modeling and sculpting workflows.
Uses adaptive triangulation to optimize mesh density, reducing polygon count in flat areas and increasing detail where needed.

params.name: Vertices Per Side
params.description: Sets the resolution of the mesh by specifying the number of vertices along each side. Higher values increase detail but also file size.

params.name: Artifact Reduction
params.description: Applies post-processing to reduce visual artifacts in the mesh, such as smoothing or correcting problematic geometry.
optionDescriptions: No artifact reduction is applied; the mesh is exported as generated.
Applies minimal artifact reduction, preserving most original detail while correcting minor issues.
Applies moderate artifact reduction, balancing detail preservation with improved mesh quality.

params.name: Create Normals
params.description: If enabled, generates normal vectors for the mesh, improving shading and rendering quality in 3D applications.

params.name: Create UVs
params.description: If enabled, generates UV coordinates for the mesh, allowing textures to be mapped accurately onto the surface.

params.name: UV Origin
params.description: Specifies the origin point for the UV coordinate system, affecting how textures are mapped onto the mesh.
optionDescriptions: Sets the UV origin to the top-left corner, matching conventions used in some graphics applications.
Sets the UV origin to the bottom-left corner, standard in most 3D engines and texture workflows.

params.name: Create Walls
params.description: Creates vertical walls along the edges of the mesh, useful for generating closed or extruded terrain models.

params.name: Center Pivot
params.description: If enabled, centers the mesh's pivot point at the origin, making it easier to manipulate in 3D applications.

params.name: Level of Detail
params.description: Specifies the level of detail (LOD) for the exported mesh, allowing for simplified versions to be generated for performance optimization.
optionDescriptions: Exports the mesh at full resolution with no LOD applied.
Exports a simplified mesh with reduced detail, suitable for distant rendering or performance-sensitive applications.
Exports a further simplified mesh with even fewer polygons.
Exports a mesh with progressively lower detail, useful for very distant or background objects.
Exports a highly simplified mesh, minimizing polygon count for maximum performance.
Exports an extremely low-detail mesh, suitable for extreme distance or preview purposes.
Exports the lowest possible detail mesh, retaining only the broadest features.

nodes.name: Meshify
nodes.description: Converts terrain into a faceted, mesh-like surface with controllable vertex density and detail sensitivity.

params.name: Vertices
params.description: Sets the number of vertices used to construct the mesh facets. Higher values produce finer, more detailed meshes; lower values create larger, more pronounced facets.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for mesh facet arrangement. Changing the seed produces different polygonal patterns and facet layouts.

params.name: Detail Sensitivity
params.description: Controls how closely the mesh facets follow the underlying terrain detail. Higher sensitivity preserves more terrain features; lower sensitivity results in smoother, more abstract faceting.

groupDetails.name: Meshify
groupDetails.description: Sets the number of vertices used to construct the mesh facets. Higher values produce finer, more detailed meshes; lower values create larger, more pronounced facets.

nodes.name: Mixer
nodes.description: Mixer allows layer-based manipulation of color textures and contains in-built masking.

nodes.name: Mountain
nodes.description: Mountain is one of Gaea's most versatile primitives, using a modulated Voronoi pattern and distortions to create realistic mountain shapes, ready for further modification and erosion.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size and extent of the mountain. Higher values create broader, more expansive mountain shapes.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum elevation of the mountain, determining how tall the peak rises above the terrain.

params.name: Style
params.description: Specifies the geological and visual style of the mountain, affecting its shape, erosion, and surface features.
optionDescriptions: Generates a simple, unmodified mountain with minimal erosion or geological detail.
Applies erosion effects to the mountain, creating realistic weathering, gullies, and worn surfaces.
Simulates an ancient mountain with softened features, rounded slopes, and significant erosion.
Creates sharp, rugged alpine features with steep faces and dramatic relief, typical of young mountain ranges.
Adds visible geological strata or layers to the mountain, emphasizing sedimentary or volcanic banding.

params.name: Bulk
params.description: Controls the mass and volume of the mountain, affecting how thick or substantial the formation appears.
optionDescriptions: Produces slender, less massive mountains with more delicate features.
Creates mountains with a balanced amount of mass, offering a natural appearance.
Generates thick, heavy mountains with substantial volume and broad bases.

params.name: Reduce Details
params.description: Reduces the amount of fine surface detail on the mountain, resulting in a smoother, more simplified shape.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the mountain. Changing the seed produces different shapes and arrangements.

params.name: X
params.description: Offsets the mountain horizontally along the X axis, shifting its position within the terrain.

params.name: Y
params.description: Offsets the mountain horizontally along the Y axis, shifting its position within the terrain.

nodes.name: MountainRange
nodes.description: Range primitive quickly sets up an entire mountain terrain with shapes highly optimized for eroding large-scale landscapes.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size and extent of the mountain ranges. Higher values create broader, more expansive ranges.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum elevation of the mountain range, determining how tall the peaks and ridges will be.

params.name: Style
params.description: Specifies the geological and visual style of the mountain range, affecting its shape, erosion, and surface features.
optionDescriptions: Generates a simple, unmodified mountain range with minimal erosion or geological detail.
Applies erosion effects to the mountain range, creating realistic weathering, gullies, and worn surfaces.
Adds visible geological strata or layers to the mountains, simulating sedimentary or volcanic banding.
Creates sharp, rugged alpine features with steep faces and dramatic relief, typical of young mountain ranges.

params.name: Bulk
params.description: Controls the mass and volume of the mountain range, affecting how thick or substantial the mountains appear.
optionDescriptions: Produces slender, less massive mountains with more delicate features.
Creates mountains with a balanced amount of mass, offering a natural appearance.
Generates thick, heavy mountains with substantial volume and broad bases.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the mountain range. Changing the seed produces different shapes and arrangements.

nodes.name: MountainSide
nodes.description: Generates a single mountain slope or mountainside formation.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size and extent of the mountain slope. Larger values create broader, more expansive slopes.

params.name: Detail
params.description: Adjusts the amount of fine surface detail on the mountain. Higher values add more texture and small-scale features to the slope.

params.name: Type
params.description: Determines the primary form of the mountain feature to generate.
optionDescriptions: Creates a continuous, sloping mountainside, ideal for simulating the flanks of large mountain ranges.
Generates a prominent mountain peak, focusing elevation and detail toward a summit.

params.name: Style
params.description: Specifies the visual and geological style of the mountain slope, affecting erosion, layering, and surface character.
optionDescriptions: Produces a simple, unmodified slope or peak with minimal erosion or geological features.
Applies erosion effects to the mountain, creating realistic weathering, gullies, and worn surfaces.
Simulates an ancient mountain with softened features, rounded slopes, and significant erosion.
Creates sharp, rugged alpine features with steep faces and dramatic relief, typical of young mountain ranges.
Adds visible geological strata or layers to the mountain, emphasizing sedimentary or volcanic banding.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Sets the orientation of the slope or peak, determining which direction the mountain face or ridge is aligned.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Defines the randomization seed for the node, ensuring reproducible or varied mountain shapes with each value.

nodes.name: MultiFractal
nodes.description: MultiFractal creates a multi-noise that can have a large level of variations. Often useful for texturing.

params.name: Noise Type
params.description: Selects the type of fractal noise used to generate the terrain. Each type produces distinct shapes and features.
optionDescriptions: Fractal Brownian Motion. Produces varied, natural-looking noise with a balanced mix of peaks and valleys.
Creates softer, rounded, and bulbous shapes, ideal for rolling hills or smooth terrain.
Generates sharp, jagged features, resulting in more dramatic and rugged terrain.

params.name: Auto Octaves
params.description: Automatically determines the optimal number of octaves for the fractal, balancing detail and performance.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: Specifies the number of noise layers (octaves) used. Higher values increase detail and complexity, but may impact performance.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size of the fractal features. Lower values create larger features, while higher values produce finer details.

params.name: Relative Feature Scale
params.description: Adjusts the scale of features relative to the terrain size, allowing for proportional detail regardless of resolution.

params.name: Roughness
params.description: Determines the roughness of the fractal. Lower values result in smoother shapes, while higher values create more rugged, detailed surfaces.

params.name: Edge smoothing
params.description: Smooths the edges of the generated terrain, reducing harsh transitions and creating a more natural appearance.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Sets the random seed for noise generation. Changing the seed produces different terrain patterns while keeping other settings the same.

params.name: Type
params.description: Selects the method of applying variation to the fractal.
optionDescriptions: Uses a secondary fractal to modulate the main fractal, adding additional layers of complexity and detail.
Applies self-modulation, where the fractal modulates itself to create more intricate and unique patterns.

params.name: Variation
params.description: Selects the method of applying variation to the fractal.

params.name: Smoothness
params.description: Adjusts the smoothness of the variation, with higher values producing gentler transitions and lower values creating sharper changes.

params.name: Contrast
params.description: Controls the contrast of the variation, increasing or decreasing the difference between high and low areas.

params.name: Damping
params.description: Reduces the intensity of variation or modulation, helping to prevent overly chaotic or extreme results.

params.name: Bias
params.description: Shifts the overall output of the variation, allowing you to favor higher or lower values in the resulting terrain.

params.name: Rotation
params.description: Rotates the fractal pattern, changing the orientation of features across the terrain.

params.name: Anisotropy
params.description: Applies directional scaling to the fractal, stretching or compressing features along a specific axis.

params.name: Offset X
params.description: Shifts the fractal pattern horizontally, moving features left or right across the terrain.

params.name: Offset Y
params.description: Shifts the fractal pattern vertically, moving features up or down across the terrain.

params.name: Perturb
params.description: Selects the type of warping applied to the fractal pattern.
optionDescriptions: No warping is applied. The fractal pattern remains unaltered.
Applies basic, soft warping to the fractal, gently distorting features for a more natural look.
Applies advanced, turbulent warping, creating highly irregular and dynamic terrain features.

params.name: Relative Size
params.description: Controls the size of the warp effect relative to the overall terrain, allowing for proportional distortion.

params.name: Strength
params.description: Sets the intensity of the warp effect. Higher values produce more pronounced distortion.

params.name: Complexity
params.description: Adjusts the complexity of the warp, increasing the number of layers or detail in the distortion.

params.name: Roughness
params.description: Determines the roughness of the fractal. Lower values result in smoother shapes, while higher values create more rugged, detailed surfaces.

params.name: Attenuation
params.description: Reduces the strength of the warp effect over distance, allowing for localized or fading distortion.

params.name: Iterations
params.description: Specifies how many times the warp effect is applied, with higher values increasing the overall distortion.

params.name: Relative Anisotropy
params.description: Controls the directional scaling of the warp effect, stretching or compressing the distortion along a specific axis.

groupDetails.name: Fractal
groupDetails.description: Selects the type of fractal noise used to generate the terrain. Each type produces distinct shapes and features.

groupDetails.name: Variation
groupDetails.description: Selects the method of applying variation to the fractal.

groupDetails.name: Position
groupDetails.description: Rotates the fractal pattern, changing the orientation of features across the terrain.

groupDetails.name: Warp
groupDetails.description: Selects the type of warping applied to the fractal pattern.

nodes.name: Noise
nodes.description: Noise applies controlled single-pixel noise onto the terrain.

params.name: Noise Type
params.description: Selects the algorithm used to generate noise. Each type produces a distinct pattern and character, suitable for different terrain or texture effects.
optionDescriptions: Generates pure random noise, resulting in a highly chaotic and unstructured pattern.
Produces smooth, gradient-based noise with natural transitions, ideal for organic terrain features.
Applies a Gaussian distribution to the noise, creating patterns with a bell-curve intensity and softer transitions.
Generates a noise pattern based on large, finite shapes.
Creates very fine, high-frequency noise suitable for adding subtle surface detail or micro-variation.

params.name: Height
params.description: Controls the maximum amplitude or elevation of the noise, affecting how pronounced the noise appears in the output.

params.name: Density
params.description: Adjusts the frequency or scale of the noise pattern. Higher density results in more frequent variations across the terrain.

params.name: Relative Density
params.description: When enabled, density is scaled relative to the current resolution or context, maintaining consistent detail at different scales.

params.name: Blend Mode
params.description: Determines how the generated noise is combined with the input or base layer, affecting the final appearance.
optionDescriptions: Adds the noise values to the input, increasing elevation or intensity where noise is present.
Multiplies the input by the noise values, modulating the base layer and enhancing contrast.
Subtracts the noise values from the input, reducing elevation or intensity in noisy areas.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Sets the randomization seed for the noise generation. Changing the seed produces a different noise pattern while keeping other settings the same.

nodes.name: Normals
nodes.description: Generates a normal map from the terrain for shading and downstream workflows.

params.name: Type
params.description: Specifies the method used to generate the normal map. Determines the level of detail and the intended use for the resulting normals.
optionDescriptions: Generates a standard normal map based on the main heightfield, suitable for general use in rendering and texturing.
Generates a high-frequency detail normal map, emphasizing fine surface features for use as a detail overlay or in advanced shading.

params.name: Width
params.description: Sets the horizontal resolution of the generated normal map in pixels. Higher values produce more detailed maps but increase memory usage.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the vertical resolution of the generated normal map in pixels. Higher values produce more detailed maps but increase memory usage.

params.name: Detail Size
params.description: Controls the scale of fine details captured in the normal map. Smaller values emphasize finer features, while larger values smooth out detail.

params.name: Handedness
params.description: Determines the coordinate system used for the normal map, affecting how normals are interpreted in different rendering engines.
optionDescriptions: Generates the normal map using a left-handed coordinate system, commonly used in some 3D applications and engines.
Generates the normal map using a right-handed coordinate system, standard in many 3D applications and engines.

params.name: Up Axis
params.description: Specifies which axis is considered 'up' for the normal map, ensuring compatibility with different engine conventions.
optionDescriptions: Sets the Y axis as the vertical (up) direction, matching engines and workflows that use Y as up.
Sets the Z axis as the vertical (up) direction, matching engines and workflows that use Z as up.

nodes.name: Object
nodes.description: Loads external object or mesh data for use inside the graph.

params.name: Mesh
params.description: Specifies the 3D mesh file to import. The mesh will be converted and rendered as a heightfield for use in terrain generation.

params.name: Relative Path
params.description: Defines the file path to the mesh relative to the project or asset directory. Ensures portability and correct asset referencing.

params.name: Drop to Floor
params.description: Automatically positions the object so its lowest point rests on the terrain base, preventing it from floating or being embedded below the surface.

params.name: Offset X
params.description: Shifts the object horizontally along the X axis, allowing precise placement within the terrain.

params.name: Offset Y
params.description: Shifts the object horizontally along the Y axis, allowing precise placement within the terrain.

params.name: Offset Z
params.description: Moves the object vertically along the Z axis, raising or lowering it relative to the terrain surface.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Group containing parameters for scaling the imported object.

params.name: Pitch
params.description: Rotates the object around the X axis, tilting it forward or backward.

params.name: Yaw
params.description: Rotates the object around the Y axis, turning it left or right.

params.name: Roll
params.description: Rotates the object around the Z axis, spinning it clockwise or counterclockwise.

params.name: Antialiasing
params.description: Enables or adjusts antialiasing for the heightfield rendering, reducing jagged edges and improving visual smoothness.

groupDetails.name: Position
groupDetails.description: Automatically positions the object so its lowest point rests on the terrain base, preventing it from floating or being embedded below the surface.

groupDetails.name: Scale
groupDetails.description: Group containing parameters for scaling the imported object.

groupDetails.name: Rotation
groupDetails.description: Rotates the object around the X axis, tilting it forward or backward.

groupDetails.name: Quality
groupDetails.description: Enables or adjusts antialiasing for the heightfield rendering, reducing jagged edges and improving visual smoothness.

nodes.name: Occlusion
nodes.description: Occlusion behaves similarly to Ambient Occlusion, but favors sedimentary processes vs. lighting.

params.name: Strength
params.description: Controls the intensity of the occlusion effect. Higher values produce deeper and more pronounced shadowing in crevices and low areas.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: Sets the number of detail layers used in the occlusion calculation. Increasing octaves adds finer detail and complexity to the occlusion shadows.

nodes.name: Origami
nodes.description: Origami creates a diagonal multifold pattern, and can produce a highly stylized terrain.

params.name: Amount
params.description: The amount of re-folding to be applied to the terrain. Low values create large folds; high values create tiny folds.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different noise patterns.

nodes.name: Outcrops
nodes.description: The Outcrops LookDev node creates rocky outcrops on any surface. You can control coverage, breakage, and surface details. Several Outcrops nodes can be layered for complex results.

params.name: Variations
params.description: Controls the number of unique outcrop shapes generated before repetition. Higher values create more visual diversity among outcrops.

params.name: Strata
params.description: Adds visible geological layering or banding to the outcrops, simulating sedimentary or stratified rock formations. High values increase the distance between Strata layers.

params.name: Density
params.description: Adjusts how many outcrops are placed across the terrain. Higher values increase the number of outcrops per area.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Determines the overall form and silhouette of each outcrop, affecting their appearance and how they blend with the terrain.

params.name: Chipped
params.description: Controls the amount of chipping or breakage on the outcrops, simulating natural weathering and erosion effects.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Sets the randomization seed for outcrop generation, ensuring reproducible or varied results with each value.

params.name: Size
params.description: Specifies the base size of each outcrop, affecting their footprint and prominence on the terrain.

params.name: Height
params.description: Controls the vertical scale of the outcrops, determining how tall or flat they appear.

params.name: Rotation
params.description: Applies random or specified rotation to each outcrop, increasing natural variation and preventing repetitive patterns.

groupDetails.name: Outcrops
groupDetails.description: Controls the number of unique outcrop shapes generated before repetition. Higher values create more visual diversity among outcrops.

groupDetails.name: Variation Range
groupDetails.description: Specifies the base size of each outcrop, affecting their footprint and prominence on the terrain.

nodes.name: Pattern
nodes.description: Generates repeatable geometric or decorative patterns for masking and stylized terrain work.

params.name: Size
params.description: Controls the overall scale of the pattern, affecting the size of the repeated elements across the terrain.

params.name: Dot Size
params.description: Sets the size of individual dots or elements within the pattern. Larger values produce bigger dots or features.

params.name: Spacing
params.description: Determines the distance between pattern elements, such as lines, dots, or grid cells. Higher values increase the gap between elements.

params.name: Steps
params.description: Specifies the number of discrete steps or repetitions in the pattern, influencing the frequency and repetition of elements.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Sets the orientation or angle of the pattern, allowing you to rotate lines, engravings, or grids as needed.

params.name: Type
params.description: Selects the style of pattern to generate. Each type produces a distinct arrangement of elements.
optionDescriptions: Generates a pattern of parallel lines, useful for striations or directional effects.
Creates a pattern resembling engraved or incised lines, adding fine detail and texture.
Produces a grid pattern with intersecting horizontal and vertical lines, forming a tiled appearance.
Generates a regular array of dots, ideal for stippling or point-based patterns.

params.name: Pixel Size
params.description: Adjusts the resolution or granularity of the pattern, controlling how fine or coarse the pattern details appear.

nodes.name: Peaks
nodes.description: Creates a mask that isolates the peaks and highest protruding parts of the terrain.

params.name: Falloff
params.description: Controls how quickly the mask transitions from the peaks and ridges to lower altitudes. Higher values create a sharper, more focused mask around the highest points.

params.name: Precise
params.description: Enables a more accurate detection of peaks and ridges, resulting in a mask that closely follows the true tips of the terrain.

nodes.name: Perlin
nodes.description: Perlin is the most basic and essential noise. In Gaea, we've made a "geo-variant" by modifying the base Perlin shape to fit the needs of terrain design from the beginning.

params.name: Type
params.description: Specifies the style of Perlin noise to generate, affecting the overall appearance and structure of the noise pattern.
optionDescriptions: Fractal Brownian Motion. Produces classic Perlin noise with layered octaves for natural, smooth terrain.
Generates ridged noise, emphasizing sharp crests and valleys for more dramatic, mountainous features.
Creates billowy, cloud-like noise with soft, rounded shapes and less pronounced valleys.

params.name: Scale
params.description: The scale of the noise. Higher values create larger, less detailed shapes. Lower values create noisier, highly detailed shapes.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: The number of noise octaves. Higher values create more complexity by layering additional detail at smaller scales.

params.name: Gain
params.description: Controls the amplitude reduction between octaves, affecting the persistence and contrast of the noise.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum elevation or intensity of the noise, scaling the output vertically.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different noise patterns.

params.name: Type
params.description: Specifies the style of Perlin noise to generate, affecting the overall appearance and structure of the noise pattern.

params.name: Frequency
params.description: Controls the frequency of the warp, determining how often the pattern is distorted across the terrain.

params.name: Amplitude
params.description: Sets the strength of the warp effect, controlling how far the noise is displaced.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: The number of noise octaves. Higher values create more complexity by layering additional detail at smaller scales.

params.name: Scale X
params.description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis, stretching or compressing the noise horizontally.

params.name: Scale Y
params.description: The non-uniform scale of the Y axis, stretching or compressing the noise vertically.

params.name: X
params.description: Offsets the Perlin noise along the X axis, shifting its position horizontally.

params.name: Y
params.description: Offsets the Perlin noise along the Y axis, shifting its position vertically.

groupDetails.name: Noise
groupDetails.description: Specifies the style of Perlin noise to generate, affecting the overall appearance and structure of the noise pattern.

groupDetails.name: Warp
groupDetails.description: Specifies the style of Perlin noise to generate, affecting the overall appearance and structure of the noise pattern.

groupDetails.name: Transform
groupDetails.description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis, stretching or compressing the noise horizontally.

nodes.name: Pixelate
nodes.description: Converts the input into a blocky, pixelated version.

nodes.name: Plates
nodes.description: Plates primitive is based on a Perlin core with flat plate-like formations created in between larger Perlin-esque shapes.

params.name: Scale
params.description: The scale of the overall field of shapes. Controls the size of the tectonic plates or regions generated by the node.

params.name: Range
params.description: Adjusts the variation in elevation or intensity between different plates, affecting the contrast and diversity of the generated regions.

params.name: Falloff
params.description: Controls the smoothness of the transitions between plates. Higher values create softer, more gradual boundaries; lower values produce sharper edges.

params.name: Warp
params.description: Applies distortion to the plate boundaries, introducing irregularity and natural variation to the shapes.

params.name: Angle
params.description: Sets the orientation or rotation of the plate pattern, allowing you to control the directional flow of the generated regions.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different plate arrangements while keeping other settings the same.

nodes.name: Pockmarks
nodes.description: Creates scattered pits, dents, and small impact-like depressions on the surface.

params.name: Size
params.description: Controls the average diameter of each pockmark. Larger values produce bigger pits, while smaller values create finer surface detail.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Sets the overall scale of the pockmark pattern, affecting how widely pockmarks are distributed across the terrain.

params.name: Depth
params.description: Specifies how deep each pockmark is carved into the surface. Higher values create more pronounced depressions.

params.name: Density
params.description: Adjusts how many pockmarks are scattered across the terrain. Higher values increase the number of pits per area.

params.name: Multiplier
params.description: Scales the intensity or strength of the pockmark effect, amplifying the impact of each depression.

params.name: Invert
params.description: Inverts the effect, turning pockmarks into raised bumps instead of depressions.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for pockmark placement and variation. Changing the seed produces different pockmark patterns.

groupDetails.name: Pockmarks
groupDetails.description: Controls the average diameter of each pockmark. Larger values produce bigger pits, while smaller values create finer surface detail.

nodes.name: PointCloud
nodes.description: Exports the terrain as a point cloud in formats such as PLY, XYZ, or CSV.

params.name: Format
params.description: Specifies the file format used for exporting the point cloud. Choose the format that best fits your workflow or target application.
optionDescriptions: Exports the point cloud in the standard ASCII PLY (Polygon File Format) format, widely supported for 3D data exchange.
Exports the point cloud in binary PLY format, offering smaller file sizes and faster read/write performance compared to ASCII.
Exports the point cloud as a simple XYZ text file, with each line representing a point's X, Y, and Z coordinates.
Exports the point cloud as a CSV (Comma-Separated Values) file, suitable for use in spreadsheets or data analysis tools.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Sets the unit or normalization method for the exported point cloud coordinates. Determines how the point positions are scaled in the output file.
optionDescriptions: Exports coordinates normalized to a 0–1 range, useful for workflows that require unitless or relative positions.
Exports coordinates in meters, matching real-world scale for compatibility with GIS and engineering applications.
Exports coordinates in kilometers, suitable for large-scale terrain or geospatial datasets.

params.name: Center Pivot
params.description: If enabled, centers the point cloud around the origin by offsetting all points so that the dataset's centroid is at (0,0,0). Useful for easier manipulation in 3D applications.

params.name: Ignore Zero Values
params.description: When enabled, points with zero or null values are excluded from the export. This helps remove empty data such as the normal low floor of the terrain from the output file.

nodes.name: RadialGradient
nodes.description: Generates a circular gradient radiating outward from a center point.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size of the radial gradient. Increasing the scale expands the gradient outward, affecting a larger area of the terrain.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum height or intensity at the center of the radial gradient. Higher values create a more pronounced peak in the center.

params.name: X
params.description: Specifies the horizontal position of the gradient's center. Adjust this value to move the gradient left or right across the terrain.

params.name: Y
params.description: Specifies the vertical position of the gradient's center. Adjust this value to move the gradient up or down across the terrain.

nodes.name: Recurve
nodes.description: Recurve is a curvature-based expander that inflates and/or deflates the terrain to create stronger slopes and larger, softer formations from a given noise or terrain.

params.name: Power
params.description: The strength of the inflate/deflate operation. Higher values cause drastic shifts in shape formation.

params.name: Scale
params.description: The amount of details to preserve. Higher values cause more prominent shapes to form.

params.name: Style
optionDescriptions: <desc>
<desc>

nodes.name: Repeat
nodes.description: Repeat takes a shape and repeats it in a tiled pattern. It is often combined with the Seamless node.

params.name: Tiles
params.description: The number of repetitions on either axis. Controls how many times the input is tiled horizontally and vertically across the terrain.

params.name: Compensate Height
params.description: Adjusts the height of each tile to prevent elevation buildup at tile seams, ensuring a smoother and more seamless repeat pattern.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum elevation for the repeated tiles, allowing you to control the overall height of the tiled output.

nodes.name: Reseed
nodes.description: Re-randomizes an upstream procedural node by overriding or refreshing its seed behavior.

nodes.name: RGBMerge
nodes.description: Combines three heightfields into a single RGB color output by packing them into separate channels.

params.name: Enhance R
params.description: Selects the enhancement method for the Red channel before merging. Adjusts the contrast and distribution of red values to improve the final output.
optionDescriptions: No enhancement is applied to the Red channel. The input values are used as-is.
Automatically stretches the Red channel's values to use the full available range, increasing contrast.
Redistributes the Red channel's values to achieve a more uniform histogram, enhancing detail and balance.

params.name: Enhance G
params.description: Selects the enhancement method for the Green channel before merging. Adjusts the contrast and distribution of green values to improve the final output.
optionDescriptions: No enhancement is applied to the Green channel. The input values are used as-is.
Automatically stretches the Green channel's values to use the full available range, increasing contrast.
Redistributes the Green channel's values to achieve a more uniform histogram, enhancing detail and balance.

params.name: Enhance B
params.description: Selects the enhancement method for the Blue channel before merging. Adjusts the contrast and distribution of blue values to improve the final output.
optionDescriptions: No enhancement is applied to the Blue channel. The input values are used as-is.
Automatically stretches the Blue channel's values to use the full available range, increasing contrast.
Redistributes the Blue channel's values to achieve a more uniform histogram, enhancing detail and balance.

nodes.name: RGBSplit
nodes.description: RGBSplit takes a color node and splits the Red/Green/Blue channels into heightfields. The counterpart to RGBMix.

params.name: Autolevel Channels
params.description: Automatically adjusts the levels of each RGB channel independently, ensuring optimal contrast and brightness for each channel after splitting.

params.name: Method
params.description: Specifies the algorithm used to split the RGB image into separate channels or grayscale outputs.
optionDescriptions: Splits the image by averaging the values of the RGB channels, producing a single grayscale output based on the mean intensity.
Uses the BT.601 standard for converting RGB to luminance, applying weighted coefficients for each channel to match broadcast video standards.
Uses the BT.709 standard for RGB to luminance conversion, applying weights optimized for HD video and modern displays.
Extracts only the red channel from the RGB image, outputting its values as a grayscale map.

nodes.name: Ridge
nodes.description: Ridge creates a rugged ridgeline with multiple fractures and rock shearing.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Scale of the ridgeline.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the height of the ridge.

params.name: Definition
params.description: Adds details on the ridgelines.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

params.name: Scale X
params.description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis.

params.name: Scale Y
params.description: The non-uniform scale of the Y axis.

groupDetails.name: Advanced
groupDetails.description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis.

nodes.name: Rivers
nodes.description: Rivers creates a realistic network of rivers with controllable headwaters.

params.name: Water
params.description: The amount of water in headwaters. Higher values can create larger rivers.

params.name: Width
params.description: The width of the rivers. High values create wide rivers, with somewhat wide tributaries. Low values create thin rivers with thin tributaries.

params.name: Depth
params.description: The depth of the rivers. This value is independent of Downcutting.

params.name: Downcutting
params.description: Like with the Erosion node, Downcutting decides how deeply the river should cut into rock and soil while moving forward.

params.description: The number of headwaters from which rivers can start. Not all will become rivers, but rather tributaries that feed the main river.

params.name: Render Surface
params.description: Whether to render the surface of the water or just create masks.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

nodes.name: RockMap

nodes.name: Rockscape
nodes.description: Creates broad rocky surface formations and broken stone-like terrain detail.

params.name: Size
params.description: Controls the overall scale of the rock formations. Higher values produce larger, more expansive rock features.

params.name: Erosion
params.description: Adjusts the amount of erosion applied to the rockscape, simulating natural weathering and smoothing of rock surfaces.

params.name: Breakage
params.description: Determines the degree of fracturing and splitting in the rocks, creating more jagged and broken surfaces as the value increases.

params.name: Roughness
params.description: Sets the surface roughness of the rocks, adding fine detail and texture to the formations.

params.name: Jitter
params.description: Introduces randomness to the placement and shape of rock features, making the rockscape appear more natural and less uniform.

params.name: Clusters
params.description: Controls the clustering behavior of rock formations, affecting how rocks group together or remain isolated.
optionDescriptions: Disables clustering, resulting in evenly distributed rock features.
Creates large clusters of rocks, forming prominent groupings and massifs.
Generates small, tight clusters of rocks, producing scattered groupings across the surface.
Simulates shattered rock formations, with highly fragmented and irregular clusters.

params.name: Relief
params.description: Specifies the style of surface relief, affecting the sharpness and layering of the rockscape.
optionDescriptions: No additional relief is applied; the surface remains as generated by the base parameters.
Applies sharp, pronounced relief, emphasizing angular features and steep transitions.
Applies soft, gentle relief, smoothing out transitions and creating a more weathered appearance.
Adds visible stratification or layering to the rockscape, simulating sedimentary or banded rock formations.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the rockscape. Changing the seed produces different rock patterns.

nodes.name: Sandstone
nodes.description: Creates layered sandstone-like terracing and sedimentary rock structure.

params.name: Passes
params.description: Sets the number of erosion passes applied to simulate layered sandstone formation. More passes increase the detail and realism of the stratified effect.

params.name: Iterations
params.description: Controls how many times the erosion process is repeated within each pass, refining the sandstone layering and surface features.

params.name: Spacing
params.description: Determines the distance between individual sandstone layers, affecting the frequency and thickness of visible strata.

params.name: Intensity
params.description: Adjusts the overall strength of the sandstone effect, influencing how pronounced the layers and erosion features appear.

params.name: Convexity
params.description: Controls the curvature of the sandstone layers, making them appear more rounded (convex) or flat.

params.name: Tilt
params.description: Applies an angular tilt to the sandstone layers, simulating geological tilting or shifting of strata.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Sets the orientation of the sandstone layers, determining the primary direction in which the strata are aligned.

params.name: Chaos
params.description: Introduces randomness and irregularity to the sandstone layers, creating a more natural and less uniform appearance.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Defines the randomization seed for procedural generation, ensuring unique but repeatable sandstone patterns.

params.name: Chipped

params.name: Chipping

params.name: Scale

params.name: Height

params.name: Density
params.description: Adjusts how many scree stones are distributed across the surface. Higher values increase the number of stones per area.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Determines how widely the scree stones are scattered from their source, affecting the coverage area and natural dispersion.

params.name: Edge

nodes.name: Sea
nodes.description: Sea is a multi-function water surface generator and coastal erosion tool. Its primary purpose is to create a water surface, while Coastal Erosion creates beaches and cliffs.

params.name: Sea
params.description: The main Sea node, responsible for generating the sea area in the terrain. Contains options to control the global and surrounding sea behavior.
optionDescriptions: Enables the sea to cover the entire terrain globally, overriding local variations.
Restricts the sea to only surround the terrain, creating a border or coastal effect rather than filling the entire area.

params.name: Level
params.description: Controls the water level of the sea. Higher values raise the sea, submerging more terrain, while lower values expose more land.

params.name: Coastal Erosion
params.description: Applies erosion to the coastal areas where the sea meets the land, simulating natural shoreline wear and shaping.

params.name: Shore Size
params.description: Determines the width of the shore created by coastal erosion. Larger values produce broader beaches or transition zones.

params.name: Shore Height
params.description: Sets the elevation difference between the sea level and the top of the shore, affecting the steepness of the coastline.

params.name: Variation
params.description: Controls the amount of natural variation and irregularity along the coastline, making the shore appear more organic and less uniform.

params.name: Uniform Variations
params.description: When enabled, applies consistent variation along the entire coast, resulting in a more uniform shoreline appearance.

params.name: Extra Cliff Details
params.description: Adds additional detail and features to cliffs along the coast, enhancing realism and visual interest in steep shoreline areas.

params.name: Render Surface
params.description: Determines whether the sea surface is rendered in the final terrain output. Enable to visualize the water surface.

nodes.name: Shade
nodes.description: Produces a shaded terrain render based on lighting direction and surface relief.

params.name: Render Style
params.description: Specifies the shading technique used to render the terrain. Each style provides a different visual representation for analysis or artistic purposes.
optionDescriptions: Renders the terrain for a stylized overview.
Applies traditional hillshading to simulate sunlight and shadow, enhancing the perception of terrain relief and surface features.
Highlights areas of the terrain that are occluded or in shadow, useful for analyzing light accessibility and terrain exposure.
Uses a soft, diffuse lighting model to gently illuminate the terrain, reducing harsh shadows and creating a more natural look.

params.name: Sun Azimuth
params.description: Sets the horizontal angle of the sun in degrees, determining the direction from which sunlight is cast across the terrain.

params.name: Sun Elevation
params.description: Controls the vertical angle of the sun above the horizon, affecting the length and intensity of shadows on the terrain.

params.name: Sunlight
params.description: Adjusts the overall intensity or brightness of direct sunlight in the shading calculation.

params.name: Shade Bias
params.description: Offsets the shading calculation to reduce or increase shadow strength, helping to fine-tune the balance between light and dark areas.

params.name: Soft Shadows
params.description: Enables or adjusts the softness of shadows, creating more gradual transitions between light and shadow for a realistic effect.

params.name: Reflected Light
params.description: Simulates indirect illumination by adding light reflected from surrounding terrain, enhancing realism and reducing overly dark shadowed areas.

params.name: High Quality
params.description: Enables high-quality rendering for shading, using more advanced calculations for smoother gradients and more accurate lighting effects.

nodes.name: Shape
nodes.description: Generates basic geometric terrain shapes for use as primitives or masks.

params.name: Geometry
params.description: Specifies the base geometric shape used for the node. Determines the fundamental outline or profile of the generated object.
optionDescriptions: Generates a circular shape as the base geometry, resulting in round or elliptical forms.
Generates a rectangular shape as the base geometry, resulting in box-like or elongated forms.

params.name: Sides
params.description: Defines the number of sides for polygonal shapes. Higher values create shapes closer to a circle, while lower values produce more angular forms.

params.name: Uniform
params.description: When enabled, ensures that scaling and transformations are applied equally in all directions, maintaining the original proportions of the shape.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size of the shape, scaling it uniformly along both the X and Y axes.

params.name: Scale X
params.description: Adjusts the width of the shape by scaling it along the X axis independently.

params.name: Scale Y
params.description: Adjusts the height of the shape by scaling it along the Y axis independently.

params.name: Thickness
params.description: Specifies the thickness of the shape's outline or border, or the width of a ring for hollow shapes.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the vertical extent or elevation of the shape, often used to define extrusion or relief in terrain generation.

params.name: X
params.description: Sets the horizontal position or offset of the shape along the X axis.

params.name: Y
params.description: Sets the vertical position or offset of the shape along the Y axis.

nodes.name: Shaper
nodes.description: Shaper bulks up or bulks down a terrain, while optionally retaining the finer details.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Negative values will bulk down the shape, while positive values will bulk up the shape.

params.name: Local Effect
params.description: Limits the shaping effect to localized regions instead of applying it globally, allowing for targeted adjustments.

params.name: Local Area
params.description: Specifies the size or extent of the local region affected when 'Local Effect' is enabled. Larger values increase the area of influence.

params.name: Maintain Fine Details
params.description: When enabled, finer detail is preserved regardless of shape changes.

params.name: Detail Size
params.description: Controls the scale of details to be preserved or affected during shaping. Smaller values focus on finer details, while larger values affect broader features.

nodes.name: Sharpen
nodes.description: Sharpen enhances terrain edges and small structures by making them more prominent.

params.name: Method
params.description: Selects the sharpening technique to apply to the terrain or texture. Each method targets different aspects of the data for sharpening.
optionDescriptions: Sharpens the terrain or texture by enhancing edges, making transitions between features more pronounced.
Sharpens by boosting high-frequency details, increasing the clarity of fine structures and textures.

params.name: Amount
params.description: The amount of sharpening to be applied to the structures. Higher values produce a stronger sharpening effect.

nodes.name: Shatter
nodes.description: Shatter transforms simple shapes into complex, highly eroded, and fractured terrains.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

nodes.name: Shear
nodes.description: Shear creates rock shearing and exposes strata.

params.name: Strength
params.description: The amount of terrain warp/shear that will be applied.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

nodes.name: Shrubs
nodes.description: Adds low vegetation or shrub-like surface growth across the terrain.

params.name: Count in Thousands
params.description: Specifies the number of shrubs to generate, in thousands. Controls the overall density of shrubs across the terrain.

params.name: Is Relative
params.description: If enabled, the shrub count is relative to the terrain size or other factors, rather than being an absolute number.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Determines the shape or type of shrub clusters to be placed. Affects the visual appearance and distribution pattern of shrubs.
optionDescriptions: Places individual shrubs as single points, resulting in a scattered, sparse distribution.
Generates larger shrub clusters, simulating denser or more mature shrub growth.
Restricts placement to only large shrub clusters, omitting individual or small shrubs.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Sets the randomization seed for shrub placement, ensuring reproducible or varied results.

params.name: Seek Water
params.description: Determines how shrubs respond to water sources, influencing their tendency to grow near or away from water.
optionDescriptions: Shrubs preferentially grow closer to water sources, increasing density near moist areas.
Shrubs avoid water sources, resulting in sparser growth near moist areas.

params.name: Avoid Trees
params.description: Controls how shrubs interact with tree placement, affecting their distribution relative to trees.
optionDescriptions: Shrubs are placed without regard to tree locations.
Shrubs avoid areas where trees were previously placed, reducing overlap.
Shrubs avoid all tree-covered areas, ensuring no overlap between shrubs and trees.

params.name: Health
params.description: Represents the overall health or vigor of shrubs, affecting their size, density, and appearance.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Controls how far shrubs can spread from their initial placement, influencing patch size and coverage.

params.name: Random
params.description: Introduces randomness to shrub placement and growth, creating more natural and varied patterns.

params.name: Simulation Bias
params.description: Adjusts the simulation to favor certain environmental conditions or behaviors, influencing shrub distribution.

params.name: Slope
params.description: Limits shrub growth on steep slopes, simulating natural growth patterns where shrubs prefer gentler terrain.

params.name: Slope Falloff
params.description: Controls how quickly shrub density decreases as slope increases.

params.name: Altitude
params.description: Restricts shrub growth above or below certain altitudes, simulating elevation-based vegetation zones.

params.name: Altitude Falloff
params.description: Controls the rate at which shrub density decreases with altitude.

params.name: Dead Flow
params.description: Prevents shrub growth in areas with stagnant or 'dead' water flow, simulating natural avoidance of such regions.

params.name: Consolidate Flows
params.description: Encourages shrubs to grow along consolidated water flow paths, such as stream banks or drainage lines.

params.name: Bias
params.description: Applies a directional or environmental bias to shrub placement, favoring certain areas or conditions.

params.name: Chaos
params.description: Increases the irregularity and unpredictability of shrub placement, creating a more natural look.

params.name: Blur Edges
params.description: Softens the boundaries of shrub patches, blending them more smoothly into the surrounding terrain.

params.name: Custom Influence
params.description: Allows custom input maps or masks to influence shrub placement and density.

params.name: Trim
params.description: Removes or reduces shrubs in specified areas, providing manual control over final distribution.

groupDetails.name: Shrubs
groupDetails.description: Specifies the number of shrubs to generate, in thousands. Controls the overall density of shrubs across the terrain.

groupDetails.name: Growth
groupDetails.description: Determines how shrubs respond to water sources, influencing their tendency to grow near or away from water.

groupDetails.name: Aspect Inhibition
groupDetails.description: Limits shrub growth on steep slopes, simulating natural growth patterns where shrubs prefer gentler terrain.

groupDetails.name: Snow Inhibition
groupDetails.description: Prevents shrub growth in areas with stagnant or 'dead' water flow, simulating natural avoidance of such regions.

groupDetails.name: Artistic Control
groupDetails.description: Increases the irregularity and unpredictability of shrub placement, creating a more natural look.

groupDetails.name: Custom Inhibitors
groupDetails.description: Allows custom input maps or masks to influence shrub placement and density.

nodes.name: Slope
nodes.description: Slope creates a selection mask within the slope range specified.

params.name: Range
params.description: Sets the minimum and maximum slope angles to include. Only terrain within this range is selected in the mask.

params.name: Falloff
params.description: Controls the soft transition at the range boundaries. Higher values create a smoother, more gradual blend from selected to unselected areas.

params.name: Type
params.description: Defines the slope calculation method, affecting how the mask interprets and distributes slope values.
optionDescriptions: Uses precise slope computation for more realistic, detail-preserving results.
Produces a consistent, even distribution across the slope range, useful for stylized or uniform masks.

params.name: Micro Accent
params.description: Enhances fine details and subtle variations in the slope mask, adding extra texture and definition to small-scale features.

nodes.name: SlopeBlur

params.name: Iterations
params.description: Specifies how many times the slope blur operation is applied. More iterations increase the smoothness and diffusion of the blur.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Sets the primary direction in which the blur is applied. Adjusting this value changes the orientation of the blur effect across the terrain.

params.name: Asymmetry
params.description: Controls the asymmetry of the blur, allowing the effect to be stronger in one direction than the other for more natural or stylized results.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Sets the primary direction in which the slope warp is applied. Adjust this to control the orientation of the warping across the terrain.

params.name: Normalized
params.description: When enabled, normalizes the effect so that the intensity is consistent regardless of terrain scale or resolution.

nodes.name: Snow
nodes.description: Snow simulates snow fall, melt, and settling like in nature, and controls how the snow adheres and flows along the terrain.

params.name: Duration
params.description: Controls the length of time snow accumulates on the terrain, affecting overall snow coverage and depth.

params.name: Intensity
params.description: Determines the rate at which snow falls and accumulates, influencing the thickness and density of the snow layer.

params.name: Settle Duration
params.description: Specifies the time it takes for freshly fallen snow to settle and compact, impacting the smoothness and stability of the snow surface.

params.name: Melt Type
params.description: Defines the method by which snow melts from the terrain, affecting the pattern and distribution of melting.
optionDescriptions: Snow melts evenly across the entire terrain, resulting in a consistent reduction of snow coverage.
Snow melts preferentially in a specific direction, simulating effects such as sun exposure or wind, leading to uneven snow retreat.

params.name: Melt
params.description: Defines the method by which snow melts from the terrain, affecting the pattern and distribution of melting.

params.name: Melt Remnants
params.description: Specifies the amount and appearance of snow left behind after melting, such as patches or traces of residual snow.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Sets the primary direction for directional melting, influencing which areas of the terrain lose snow first.

params.name: Snow Line
params.description: Defines the altitude or threshold below which snow does not accumulate, simulating natural snow lines on mountains.

params.name: Slip-off angle
params.description: Specifies the minimum slope angle at which snow will slide off, affecting snow accumulation on steep surfaces.

params.name: Adhered snow mass
params.description: Controls the amount of snow that remains attached to surfaces, even on steep or vertical terrain.

params.name: Model scale
params.description: Sets the scale of the terrain model, influencing how snow parameters are interpreted relative to real-world dimensions.

params.name: Real Scale
params.description: Specifies the actual physical scale represented by the terrain, used for accurate snow simulation and parameter scaling.

params.name: Terrain Scale
params.description: Adjusts the scaling factor for the terrain, affecting how snow features are distributed and visualized.

params.name: Verticality
params.description: Controls the influence of vertical surfaces on snow accumulation, determining how much snow can adhere to cliffs and steep slopes.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Sets the randomization seed for snow distribution, ensuring reproducible results or introducing variation in snow patterns.

groupDetails.name: Snow
groupDetails.description: Controls the length of time snow accumulates on the terrain, affecting overall snow coverage and depth.

groupDetails.name: Melt
groupDetails.description: Defines the method by which snow melts from the terrain, affecting the pattern and distribution of melting.

groupDetails.name: Advanced
groupDetails.description: Specifies the minimum slope angle at which snow will slide off, affecting snow accumulation on steep surfaces.

nodes.name: SoftClip
nodes.description: SoftClip a low-level utility that lets you softly reduce the intensity of shapes above a specified threshold. It can be comparable to masking a shape with a Height node and then clamping that portion.

params.name: Clip Mode
params.description: Selects whether the soft clipping effect is applied above or below the specified threshold.
optionDescriptions: Applies soft clipping to values above the threshold, gently compressing high values toward the threshold.
Applies soft clipping to values below the threshold, gently compressing low values toward the threshold.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: Sets the value at which soft clipping begins. Values above or below this threshold (depending on mode) will be affected.

params.name: Softness
params.description: Controls the smoothness of the transition at the threshold. Higher values create a more gradual, less abrupt clipping effect.

params.name: Clipping
params.description: Adjusts the overall strength of the clipping effect, determining how much values are compressed toward the threshold.

nodes.name: Soil
nodes.description: Soil Map creates a soil mask, with increased density in crevices or other areas where the slope allows soil to settle.

nodes.name: Splat
nodes.description: Splat is similar to RGBMix, taking heightfield nodes and encoding them to the RGB channels of a color map, and providing properties to control the inputs.

params.name: R
params.description: Amount of R input channel.

params.name: G
params.description: Amount of G input channel.

params.name: B
params.description: Amount of B input channel.

params.name: A
params.description: Amount of alpha input channel.

params.name: Autolevel
params.description: Automatically adjusts the levels of the combined channels to maximize the output range.

params.name: Clamp Product
params.description: Clamps the product of the R, G, and B channels to the 0..1 range, ensuring the output does not exceed valid limits.

nodes.name: Steps
nodes.description: Creates stepped formations and hard terrace-like breaks in the terrain.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size and spacing of the steps. Higher values produce larger, more widely spaced terraces, while lower values create finer, closely packed steps.

params.name: Density
params.description: Determines the number of steps or terraces within the terrain. Increasing density results in more steps, creating a more detailed and intricate terraced effect.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Sets the random seed for the step pattern. Changing the seed generates a different arrangement of steps while keeping other settings the same.

groupDetails.name: Steps
groupDetails.description: Controls the overall size and spacing of the steps. Higher values produce larger, more widely spaced terraces, while lower values create finer, closely packed steps.

nodes.name: Stones
nodes.description: Scatters stones or small rock forms across the surface.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size of the stones. Higher values produce larger stones, while lower values create finer gravel.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum elevation or prominence of the stones above the terrain surface.

params.name: Density
params.description: Adjusts how many stones are scattered across the surface. Higher values increase the number of stones per area.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for stone placement and variation. Changing the seed produces different stone patterns.

groupDetails.name: Stones
groupDetails.description: Controls the overall size of the stones. Higher values produce larger stones, while lower values create finer gravel.

nodes.name: Stratify
nodes.description: Stratify creates broken strata or rock layers on the terrain in a non-linear fashion, producing a robust, realistic formation.

params.name: Spacing
params.description: Controls the distance between individual stratified layers, affecting the frequency and thickness of visible strata in the terrain.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: Sets the number of noise octaves used to add variation to the stratified layers. Higher values introduce more complexity and detail.

params.name: Intensity
params.description: Adjusts the overall strength of the stratification effect, making the layers more or less pronounced.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Modifies the profile or contour of the stratified layers, influencing how sharply or smoothly the layers transition.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Defines the randomization seed for procedural generation, ensuring unique but repeatable stratification patterns.

params.name: Tilt Amount
params.description: Applies an angular tilt to the stratified layers, simulating geological tilting or shifting of strata.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Sets the orientation of the stratified layers, determining the primary direction in which the strata are aligned.

nodes.name: Sunlight
nodes.description: Sunlight is a Data Map that gives you the sunlight integral (sun light/shadow map) of any given period (up to 365 days). It can be used to drive snow melt, vegetation growth, and more.

params.name: Soil

nodes.name: Thermal
nodes.description: Thermal simulates Thermal Erosion to create talus and debris.

params.name: Duration
params.description: Controls how long the thermal erosion process is applied. Higher values result in more extensive terrain changes over time.

params.name: Strength
params.description: Sets the intensity of thermal erosion. Increasing this value produces more pronounced smoothing and displacement, especially on steep slopes.

params.name: Anisotropy
params.description: Adjusts the directional bias of erosion and deposit formation. Low values preserve the original terrain, while high values intensify directional erosion, shaping talus deposits and terrain features.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomizes the erosion pattern while keeping other settings unchanged, allowing for varied results without retuning parameters.

params.name: Angle
params.description: Sets the maximum slope angle before material begins to move downward, forming talus. Lower angles create gentler slopes, while higher angles allow steeper terrain before shifting occurs.

params.name: Settling
params.description: Controls how quickly and thoroughly loose material settles after being eroded. Higher values result in faster, more complete settling, while lower values allow for gradual accumulation.

params.name: Sediment Removal
params.description: Determines the amount of sediment removed during talus formation. Higher values produce cleaner, sharper features, while lower values allow more sediment to accumulate, creating smoother transitions.

params.name: Feature Scale
params.description: Sets the scale of the largest thermal erosion features in the terrain. Larger values create broader, more pronounced features; smaller values result in finer details.

params.name: Real Scale
params.description: Uses the scale defined by the terrain's physical dimensions. Disable to access additional options and manually adjust erosion physics.

params.name: Terrain Scale
params.description: Specifies the overall scale of the terrain when Real Scale is turned off, allowing for manual adjustment of terrain size.

params.name: Verticality
params.description: Controls the height of the terrain when Real Scale is turned off, enabling further customization of vertical exaggeration.

nodes.name: ThermalShaper
nodes.description: ThermalShaper is a fast, basic simulation of the concavity and convexity that can be achieved from thermal erosion. The effect can be exaggerated for artistic effect.

params.name: Influence
params.description: Controls the overall strength of the thermal shaping effect applied to the input terrain. Higher values increase the impact, blending more of the thermal shaping with the original terrain. Mid-range values provide a balance between the effect and the source terrain.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Adjusts the shaping style of the terrain. Negative values condense the terrain into sharp, concise ridges, while positive values bulk up the terrain, creating softer, more rounded features.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Sets the scale at which the thermal shaping is applied. Lower values focus the effect on smaller details and individual ridges, while higher values apply the shaping to larger terrain features, affecting broader mountain ranges.

params.name: Microdetail Preservation
params.description: Preserves fine details from the original terrain during thermal shaping. Higher values maintain more microdetail, such as rocky textures and small features, while lower values result in smoother, more uniform terrain.

params.description: Shifts the terrain or object horizontally along the X axis, allowing precise placement within the scene.

params.name: Offset Y
params.description: Shifts the terrain or object horizontally along the Y axis, moving it forward or backward in the workspace.

params.name: Offset Z
params.description: Moves the terrain or object vertically along the Z axis, raising or lowering its elevation.

params.name: Uniform
params.description: Applies uniform scaling to all axes, maintaining the original proportions of the terrain or object.

params.description: Applies uniform scaling to all axes, maintaining the original proportions of the terrain or object.

params.description: The non-uniform scale on the X axis, allowing independent horizontal stretching or compression.

params.name: Angle
params.description: The angle of rotation applied to the terrain or object, measured in degrees.

Adds the transformed values to the input, increasing elevation or intensity.

Emphasizes the difference between the transformed data and the input.
Multiplies the transformed data with the input, modulating the result.
Uses a screen blend, lightening the result where both inputs are present.
Takes the maximum value between the transformed data and the input at each point.
Takes the minimum value between the transformed data and the input at each point.

params.name: Edges
params.description: Specifies how the edges of the transformed terrain or object are handled.
optionDescriptions: No special edge handling; edges may be abrupt or unblended.
Applies a thin edge blend, softening the transition at the boundaries.
Applies a wide edge blend, creating a broader transition zone at the boundaries.
Applies a soft, gradual edge blend for smooth transitions.

params.name: Extend

params.name: Flatten
