nodes.name: Trees
nodes.description: The Arboreal Node gives you the power of creating superficial forests and vegetation. These forests are part of the heightfield while being "detached" enough for various export scenarios.

params.name: Output
params.description: Determines the output type for tree placement. 'Instances' provides individual tree positions for rendering and export. 'AreaMask' is an experimental feature that outputs a mask of tree coverage, useful for blending or exclusion but may be less reliable.
optionDescriptions: Outputs individual tree instance data for use in rendering, simulation, or export. Recommended for stable and reliable results.
Outputs a mask indicating areas where trees are placed. Useful for visualization and blending, but currently experimental and may produce less predictable results.

params.name: Count in Thousands
params.description: Sets the number of trees to be placed, specified in thousands. Higher values increase density and mask quality but may impact performance and memory usage.

params.name: Is Relative
params.description: If enabled, tree count scales with terrain resolution for consistent density. Recommended for predictable results at higher resolutions, but may increase resource usage.

params.name: LOD Info
params.description: Provides Level of Detail (LOD) information for tree instances, enabling optimized rendering and export at different distances or resolutions.

params.name: Tree Size
params.description: Controls the height of each tree instance. Affects the appearance of exported trees but not the mask. Useful for adjusting the final look of tree outputs.

params.name: Trim Under
params.description: Removes tree instances below a certain size threshold, clamping down on smaller or weaker trees to refine the mask and output.

params.name: Shape
params.description: Specifies the distribution pattern or type of tree shapes. 'Point' is a single pixel, 'Big' is a larger square, and 'BigOnly' restricts placement to large clusters. 'Big' is preferred for mask export, while 'Point' is better for visualization.
optionDescriptions: Places trees as single small pixels, resulting in sparse and detailed distribution. Best for internal visualization.
Places larger tree shapes, creating denser and more legible masks. Preferred for exporting tree masks.
Restricts placement to only large tree clusters, excluding smaller or individual trees for a bold mask.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Sets the randomization seed for procedural tree placement. Changing the seed produces different tree layouts and simulation results.

params.name: Seek Water
params.description: Controls whether trees grow near water flows ('Seek') or away from them ('Avoid'). Useful for simulating species preferences and biomes.
optionDescriptions: Trees preferentially grow near water sources and flow areas, simulating water-loving species.
Trees avoid water sources and flow areas, simulating species that prefer drier conditions.

params.name: Avoid Trees
params.description: Masks out areas occupied by other tree nodes, useful for stacking multiple tree species or biomes without overlap.
optionDescriptions: No avoidance; trees can be placed close together or overlap with other tree nodes.
New trees avoid areas occupied by the previously placed tree node, reducing overlap in stacked nodes.
New trees avoid all other tree nodes in the stack, maximizing spacing and separation.

params.name: Health
params.description: Controls the duration and vigor of the tree simulation. Higher health increases density and allows trees to grow into smaller valleys and more challenging terrain. Lower health restricts growth to main flow areas.

params.name: Patches
params.description: Clumps trees together into larger groups, creating stylized patches instead of individual trees. Useful for natural-looking forests.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Blurs and expands the area where trees can grow, merging small flows into larger masses and creating more natural, contiguous forest areas.

params.name: Random
params.description: Adds random noise to tree placement, scattering trees across the terrain without regard to inhibition or aspect controls. Rarely used for realistic masks.

params.name: Slope
params.description: Restricts tree growth on steep terrain. Not recommended when using a custom inhibition mask, as the mask provides more accurate control.

params.name: Slope Falloff
params.description: Controls how quickly tree density decreases as slope increases. Use with slope inhibition for gradual or sharp transitions.

params.name: Altitude
params.description: Sets altitude limits for tree placement, simulating elevation-based growth restrictions. Works well with both aspect inhibition and custom masks.

params.name: Altitude Falloff
params.description: Controls the rate at which tree density decreases with altitude, enabling smooth or sharp transitions in elevation-based inhibition.

params.name: Peaks
params.description: Removes tree growth from exposed mountain peaks, preventing trees from growing in the most exposed areas.

params.name: Strict
params.description: Enforces strict adherence to inhibition rules, resulting in sharper falloff and less natural tree distribution. Use for precise, non-organic masks.

params.name: Dead Flow
params.description: Represents areas where tree growth is suppressed due to snow mass or adverse conditions. Controls the amount of snow mass moving down the terrain.

params.name: Consolidate Flows
params.description: Groups snow flows into larger masses, affecting how far snow moves down the terrain and influencing tree inhibition.

params.name: Bias
params.description: Directs snow flows to move less or more, affecting the inhibition of tree growth in snowy areas.

params.name: Snowline
params.description: Defines the altitude at which snow flows start, restricting tree growth above this line.

params.name: Chaos
params.description: Warps tree positions for a more natural, randomized look, breaking up straight flows and adding organic variation.

params.name: Blur Edges
params.description: Softens and tapers the edges of tree patches, blending them into the terrain for a more natural transition.

params.name: Visualize Data
params.description: Enables visualization of tree placement, flows, and snow inhibition, assisting with mask tuning and debugging.

params.name: Custom Influence
params.description: Applies custom influence maps or masks to control tree placement according to user specifications, enabling highly tailored results.

params.name: Trim
params.description: Removes trees from specified areas, allowing for manual or procedural clearing of tree patches for refined mask output.

nodes.name: Uplift
nodes.description: Creates tectonic-style uplift by raising and shaping large terrain masses.

nodes.name: Var
nodes.description: Reads or modifies named graph variables for procedural control and automation.

params.name: Edit Mode
params.description: Specifies how the variable is used in the node. 'Consume' reads the value of an existing variable, while 'Modify' changes the value or applies an expression to the variable.
optionDescriptions: Reads and uses the value of the specified variable without altering it.
Applies an expression or new value to the variable, updating its value for subsequent nodes.

params.name: Variable Name
params.description: The name of the variable to consume or modify. This should match the variable defined elsewhere in the graph or macro.

params.name: Expression
params.description: An optional mathematical or logical expression to apply when modifying the variable. Used only in 'Modify' mode.

params.name: Default Value
params.description: The value to use if the specified variable is not set or available. Ensures the node has a fallback value.

nodes.name: VariableBlur
nodes.description: Blurs the input by varying the blur amount across the surface using local data or a guide.

params.name: Radius
params.description: Controls the blur radius for each pixel. The radius can vary across the image, enabling localized or mask-driven blur effects.

groupDetails.name: Blur
groupDetails.description: Controls the blur radius for each pixel. The radius can vary across the image, enabling localized or mask-driven blur effects.

nodes.name: Volcano
nodes.description: Generates a volcanic landform with a central cone and crater structure.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Controls the overall size of the volcano feature in the terrain. Increasing the scale makes the volcano larger relative to the surrounding landscape.

params.name: Height
params.description: Sets the maximum elevation of the volcano. Higher values produce taller volcanic structures.

params.name: Mouth
params.description: Defines the diameter of the volcano's crater opening. Adjusting this parameter changes how wide or narrow the mouth appears.

params.name: Bulk
params.description: Determines the mass and thickness of the volcano's body. Higher bulk values result in a more massive and robust volcano shape.

params.name: Surface
params.description: Specifies the surface characteristics of the volcano, allowing selection between different terrain styles for the outer slopes.
optionDescriptions: Applies a smooth surface to the volcano, minimizing roughness and erosion effects for a clean, uniform appearance.
Applies erosion effects to the volcano's surface, simulating weathered and worn terrain with more natural detail.

params.name: X
params.description: Sets the horizontal position of the volcano on the terrain grid. Adjust to move the volcano left or right.

params.name: Y
params.description: Sets the vertical position of the volcano on the terrain grid. Adjust to move the volcano up or down.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Defines the randomization seed for procedural generation. Changing the seed produces different volcano shapes and features.

nodes.name: Voronoi
nodes.description: Voronoi is a staple of procedural design and creates sharp, geometric patterns. In Gaea, we've made a "geo-variant" by modifying the base Voronoi shape to fit the needs of terrain design from the beginning.

params.name: Scale
params.description: The perceptual scale of the Voronoi shapes. Higher values create more, smaller shapes; lower values produce fewer, larger cells.

params.name: Jitter
params.description: Controls the offset of the Voronoi points, ranging from perfectly symmetrical (low jitter) to highly chaotic (high jitter) cell placement.

params.name: Function
params.description: Specifies the distance function used to calculate Voronoi cells, affecting the shape and boundaries of each cell.
optionDescriptions: Uses the standard Euclidean distance, resulting in natural, rounded cell shapes.
Uses the Manhattan (grid-based) distance, producing square or diamond-shaped cells.

params.name: Form
params.description: Determines how the height or value of each Voronoi cell is calculated, affecting the resulting terrain or pattern.
optionDescriptions: Voronoi cells with height determined by the cell itself, creating classic cell-based patterns.
Voronoi cells with height determined by the nearest neighbor, resulting in smoother transitions between cells.
Voronoi cells with height influenced by the distance to the cell's edge, creating ring-like or ridge effects.
The default look for this geo-variant, suitable for creating mountainous terrain with prominent peaks.
A mix between the P and M forms, blending characteristics of both for varied terrain features.
Generates individual mountains with fully separated boundaries, emphasizing isolated peaks.
Favors the strongest cell, ideal for creating a large mountain slope or dominant landform.
Emphasizes ridges over cell centers, producing terrain with pronounced ridge lines.

params.name: Gain
params.description: Adjusts the contrast or intensity of the Voronoi pattern, amplifying or reducing the difference between cell heights.

params.name: Clamp
params.description: Limits the output values to a specified range, preventing extreme heights or depths in the generated pattern.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different Voronoi arrangements.

params.name: Type
params.description: Specifies the type of warp applied to the Voronoi pattern, controlling the complexity of the distortion.
optionDescriptions: No warping is applied; the Voronoi pattern remains unaltered.
Applies basic warping to the pattern, introducing gentle distortions.
Applies advanced, multi-layered warping for highly intricate and organic distortions.

params.name: Frequency
params.description: Controls the frequency of the warp, determining how often the pattern is distorted across the terrain.

params.name: Amplitude
params.description: Sets the strength of the warp effect, controlling how far the Voronoi cells are displaced.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: Specifies the number of detail layers used in the warp, increasing the complexity and richness of the distortion.

params.name: Scale X
params.description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis, stretching or compressing the pattern horizontally.

params.name: Scale Y
params.description: The non-uniform scale of the Y axis, stretching or compressing the pattern vertically.

params.name: X
params.description: Offsets the Voronoi pattern along the X axis, shifting its position horizontally.

params.name: Y
params.description: Offsets the Voronoi pattern along the Y axis, shifting its position vertically.

groupDetails.name: Noise
groupDetails.description: The perceptual scale of the Voronoi shapes. Higher values create more, smaller shapes; lower values produce fewer, larger cells.

groupDetails.name: Warp
groupDetails.description: Specifies the type of warp applied to the Voronoi pattern, controlling the complexity of the distortion.

groupDetails.name: Transform
groupDetails.description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis, stretching or compressing the pattern horizontally.

nodes.name: Warp
nodes.description: Warp can take the terrain and "warp" the shape creating more believable shapes or alter simple shapes into a more complex formation. It can help breakup masks too.

params.name: Size
params.description: The size of the warp noise. Controls the scale of the distortion pattern applied to the input.

params.name: Strength
params.description: The strength of the warp noise. Higher values produce more pronounced distortions.

params.name: Z Scale
params.description: Vertical axis scale for the noise, affecting the intensity of the warp along the Z (height) axis.

params.name: Warp Source
params.description: Selects the noise or pattern used as the source for the warp. Choose from built-in options or provide a custom source.
optionDescriptions: Uses Perlin fractal Brownian motion noise as the warp source, producing smooth, natural distortions.
Uses Voronoi (R) noise as the warp source, creating cell-like, ridged distortions.
Uses Voronoi (P) noise as the warp source, suitable for generating mountainous or peak-like distortions.
Uses Voronoi (A) noise as the warp source, blending characteristics of other Voronoi types for varied effects.
Uses Voronoi (S) noise as the warp source, emphasizing separated, individual cell boundaries.
Uses Voronoi (M) noise as the warp source, favoring dominant cells for strong, directional warping.
Uses Voronoi (D) noise as the warp source, emphasizing ridges and linear features in the distortion.

params.name: Perturbation
params.description: Applies additional random displacement to the warp, increasing the irregularity and complexity of the effect.

params.name: Complexity
params.description: The complexity of the warp noise source. Higher values add more detail and layers to the distortion.

params.name: Roughness
params.description: The roughness of the warp noise. Higher values (especially above 0.5) create harsher, more jagged distortions.

params.name: Normalized
params.description: Specifies whether the noise is normalized. Normalization ensures the output remains within a standard range.

params.name: Edge Behaviour
params.description: Determines how the warp handles the edges of the input, preventing visible seams or artifacts.
optionDescriptions: Applies standard edge handling, which may result in wrapping or stretching at the borders.
Edge pixels are mirrored, creating seamless, reflected borders for the warp effect.

params.name: Modulation
params.description: The amount of modulation to use from the Modulation input (if connected), allowing external control over the warp intensity.

params.name: Modulation Direction
params.description: Sets the direction of the modulation, controlling how the modulation input influences the warp.

params.name: Seed
params.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different warp results.

params.name: Iterations
params.description: Number of warp iterations to apply. More iterations increase the complexity and layering of the distortion.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Specifies the mode used for iterative warping, affecting how each pass is calculated and applied.
optionDescriptions: Applies the warp using standard bitmap-based processing for each iteration.
Uses a vector field to guide the warp, allowing for more directional and flow-based distortions.
Integrates the vector field over multiple passes, producing complex, cumulative warp effects.

groupDetails.name: Warp
groupDetails.description: The size of the warp noise. Controls the scale of the distortion pattern applied to the input.

groupDetails.name: Iterative
groupDetails.description: Number of warp iterations to apply. More iterations increase the complexity and layering of the distortion.

nodes.name: WaveShine
nodes.description: Generates wave-like reflective or rippling patterns useful for stylized surfaces and water-like forms.

params.name: Frame
params.description: Specifies the current animation frame or time step for the wave simulation, allowing for frame-by-frame control or preview.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: Sets the number of detail layers (octaves) used in the wave pattern, increasing complexity and realism with higher values.

params.name: Seed
params.description: Randomization seed for generating unique wave patterns. Changing the seed produces different wave arrangements.

params.name: Animation Speed
params.description: Controls the speed at which ripples animate across the surface, affecting how quickly the pattern evolves over time.

params.name: Size
params.description: Sets the scale of individual ripples, with larger values producing broader, more widely spaced ripples.

params.name: Amplitude
params.description: Adjusts the height or intensity of the ripples, making them more or less pronounced.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Specifies the primary direction in which ripples travel, simulating wind or current-driven movement.

params.name: Speed
params.description: Controls the movement speed of the ripples, determining how fast they propagate across the surface.

params.name: Intensity
params.description: Sets the strength of the wind patch effect, increasing the impact of wind on the wave or ripple pattern.

params.name: Contrast

params.name: Brightness

nodes.name: Weathering
nodes.description: Creates weathered color or mask variation that simulates dirt, fading, and environmental wear.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Sets the scale at which weathering effects are applied. Lower values target fine details, while higher values affect larger terrain features.

params.name: Creep
params.description: Simulates gradual movement and spreading of weathering effects across the terrain, softening transitions and blending weathered areas.

params.name: Amount
params.description: Adjusts the overall intensity of the weathering effect. Higher values produce more pronounced weathering.

params.name: Washed Out
params.description: Toggles if colors are faded or desaturated, mimicking the effect of prolonged exposure to the elements.

params.name: Inverse
params.description: Inverts the weathering effect, applying it to areas that would normally be less affected, such as recesses instead of protrusions.

params.name: Dirt
params.description: Adds darker coloration to crevices, nooks, and sheltered areas of the terrain, simulating the accumulation of soil, organic matter, or moisture.

params.name: Darker
params.description: Intensifies the darkness of the dirt effect, making crevices and nooks appear deeper and more shadowed.

params.name: Hue
params.description: Adjusts the overall hue of the weathered terrain, allowing for color shifts to match desired environmental conditions.

params.name: Saturation
params.description: Controls the intensity of colors in the weathered terrain, from muted to vibrant.

params.name: Lightness
params.description: Sets the overall brightness of the weathered terrain, affecting how light or dark the final result appears.

groupDetails.name: Primary
groupDetails.description: Sets the scale at which weathering effects are applied. Lower values target fine details, while higher values affect larger terrain features.

groupDetails.name: Post Processing
groupDetails.description: Adjusts the overall hue of the weathered terrain, allowing for color shifts to match desired environmental conditions.

params.name: Power
